**Description**
 Amazon Transportation Services is looking for a Supply Chain Manager II in our ROC (Relay Operations Center) team in India (HYD). This center supports our European and North American Middle Mile Linehaul network. The ROC team addresses disruptions in the Middle Mile network, to allow them to deliver packages safely and on time.
   

  

 The supply chain manager will help with scheduling and driving cost effective strategies for the middle mile network. This role will enable you to make data driven decisions, coordinate and drive execution, and communicate to senior management on status, risks and process/product changes. Cross\-team coordination, project management and executive presentation skills are essential.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

**A Supply Chain Manager Is Expected To**
* Think Big and identify improvement opportunities and gaps in existing process and work with key stakeholders to execute/resolve them
* Define the program (mission, vision, tenets), set objectives, analyze data and drive improvements that are quantified with metrics
* Pull data from numerous databases (using Excel, Access, SQL and/or other data management systems) and to perform reporting and analysis as needed
* Work closely with tech teams on multiple and diverse array of high scope initiatives that need to align with operational deliverables.
* Improving accuracy and quality of transportation plans for IXD
* Hold a high standard and be able to exhibit exceptional ownership and ability to disagree and commit
* Solve ambiguous problems and proactively identify and mitigate risks (before they become roadblocks)
* Develop, implement, and govern KPI reporting for a portfolio of programs, providing visibility to the milestones, and performance across all projects
* Engage other Amazon business units globally to share best practices and improve end to end outcomes for Amazon customers


**Basic Qualifications**
* 3\+ years of program or project management experience
* 3\+ years of working cross functionally with tech and non\-tech teams experience
* 3\+ years of defining and implementing process improvement initiatives using data and metrics experience
* Bachelor's degree
* Knowledge of Excel (Pivot Tables, VLookUps) at an advanced level and SQL
* Experience defining program requirements and using data and metrics to determine improvements


**Preferred Qualifications**
* 3\+ years of driving end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership experience

* Experience in stakeholder management, dealing with multiple stakeholders at varied levels of the organization

description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Relay Operations Center (ROC) is the central command and control center for ‘Transportation Execution’ across the Amazon Supply Chain network supporting multiple geographies like NA, and EU. It ensures hassle free, timely pick\-up and delivery of freight from vendors to Amazon facilities and to carrier hubs. In case of any exceptions, ROC steps in to resolve the issue and keeps all the stakeholders informed on the proceedings.  

  

In addition to this tactical problem solving, ROC is also charged with understanding trends in network exceptions and then automating processes or proposing process changes to streamline operations. This second aspect involves network monitoring and significant analysis of network data.  

  

Overall, ROC plays a critical role in ensuring the smooth functioning of Amazon transportation and thereby has a direct impact on Amazon’s ability to serve its customers on time.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:  

* Managing a shift, constantly identifying opportunities to improve team performance and owning associated change management. This is Work from Office position
* Developing and/or referring to performance metrics to drive team performance and business results.
* Identifying the business impact of trends and making data backed decisions. Able to learn and become a SME of the process (where engaged)
* Communicating with external customers (Carriers, Vendors/Suppliers) and internal customers (Retail, Finance, Software Support, Fulfillment Centers)
* Escalating problems or variances in the information and data to the relevant owners and following through on resolutions.
* Ability to pull data from numerous databases (using Excel, Access, SQL and/or other data management systems) and to perform ad hoc reporting and analysis, as needed, is a plus.
* Serves as escalation point for transportation specialists.
* Owning process/business level reports/actions and diving compliance..
* Perform Ad\-hoc reporting and analysis as per requirement.
**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 1\+ years of employee and performance management experience
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent, or 2\+ years of Amazon (blue badge/FTE) experience
* Work a flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in supply chain management, operations, engineering, analytics or related field

description:
**Description**
 The Worldwide Operations Security (WWOS) Global Security Operations Center (GSOC) is Amazon’s 24/7 centralized command center supporting Worldwide Amazon Stores. The GSOC manages critical incidents impacting life safety, operational continuity, and brand reputation by connecting sites with the appropriate subject matter experts and coordinating end\-to\-end incident response. We accomplish this by creating policy and implementation guidelines; training leadership and staff; using technology to eliminate subjectivity, complexity, and variation; identifying, preparing for, and mitigating risk; and auditing our practices to ensure compliance.
   

  

 The Security Operations Manager, Global Security Operations Center (GSOC) will provides critical support and timely notification to global partners regarding incidents that have impacted, or have the potential to impact, Life Safety, Operations, and/or the Amazon Brand. They will assist in managerial ownership of their shift and be responsible for ensuring performance SLAs are met, that responses are appropriate according to policies and procedures, and for developing and motivating a highly performant staff. The Security Operations Manager must also deal effectively with ambiguity and make response\-related decisions sometimes with incomplete information in the best interest of Amazon.
   

  

 The successful candidate must have a proven record of effective leadership capabilities and demonstrate elevated judgment while operating under pressure. They must possess the ability to operate autonomously, use discretion when dealing with sensitive and critical information, and apply sound business principles to identify barriers and initiate actions to resolve. The candidate should possess a proven record of working across multiple organizations to resolve escalations where the problem and solutions, as well as risk strategy, may not be well defined.
   

  

 The GSOC is a 24/7/365 operation, and this position will require shift work, including night and weekend shifts.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Lead 24/7 GSOC shift operations, ensuring timely triage, escalation, and resolution of incidents impacting life safety, operational continuity, and Amazon’s brand.
* Provide timely notifications, situation reports, and executive briefings to global stakeholders
* Ensure shift operational excellence by maintaining ownership of performance, achieving established Service Level Agreements (SLAs), and driving consistent execution of policies and procedures
* Partner with Security, Operations, HR, Workplace Health \& Safety (WHS), Legal, Communications and other internal stakeholders to coordinate effective incident response and business continuity support.
* Lead, coach, and develop a high\-performing team of Operations Security Specialists by setting clear expectations, providing regular coaching and feedback, and fostering a culture of accountability, operational excellence, and continuous learning.
* Monitor incident trends, operational metrics, and emerging risks to identify opportunities for process improvements, strengthen response capabilities, and reduce recurring issues.
* Lead post\-incident reviews and drive corrective actions that improve operational resilience, standardize best practices, and enhance the effectiveness of global incident management.
* Partner with cross\-functional and global teams to develop, implement, and continuously improve processes, tools, and operational standards that support scalable, efficient GSOC operations.
* Maintain the highest standards of professionalism, sound judgment, confidentiality, and customer obsession while protecting Amazon’s associates, operations, and brand.


 A day in the life
   

  

 As a GSOC Security Operations Manager, you will lead a team responsible for managing critical security and operational incidents across Amazon’s global network. Your day may include directing responses to workplace emergencies, severe weather events, security threats, transportation incidents, or operational disruptions while coordinating with multiple business partners and executive stakeholders. You will coach your team in real time, provide strategic guidance during escalations, ensure operational metrics are met, and continuously improve processes that strengthen Amazon’s global incident management capability.

**Overview**
**JOB DESCRIPTION**
 At Peloton, we don't just implement technology. We transform the way organizations work, compete, and grow. Recognized on the Inc. 5000 list of fastest\-growing companies in the US, Peloton is one of the most respected and fastest\-growing global Oracle consulting firms, delivering Advisory, Consulting, and Managed Services to leading organizations across many industries, including Retail, Financial Services, Manufacturing, Consumer Packaged Goods, and more.
   

  

 Peloton Consulting Group has the vision and connected global capabilities to help organizations envision, implement, and realize the benefits of digital transformation. Our team has the best practices, knowledge, industry expertise, and know\-how. We make digital transformation a reality by leveraging AI, Enterprise Performance Management (EPM), Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP), Supply Chain Management (SCM), Human Capital Management (HCM), Customer Experience (CX), Analytics, and Data Management for the cloud. Through connected capabilities, we bring people, processes, and technology together. We help organizations go further faster. That is the Peloton way!
   

  

 What truly sets us apart is our people. We are team players. We are energetic and entrepreneurial. We are problem solvers and innovative thinkers who believe the best outcomes are built together. We believe in quality, appreciate creativity, recognize individual contributions, and place trust in every member of our team. If you bring strong business or technical expertise and want to do meaningful work alongside people who are equally passionate about getting it right, we think you'll feel right at home here.
   

  

 Peloton is looking to expand our Close and Consolidation capabilities. We are looking for candidates, across all levels that are interested in the opportunity to play a role in the growth and development of Peloton’s Financial Reporting \& Consolidations Practice. We are specifically looking for team members with demonstrated experience with Oracle \| Hyperion Financial Management, Cloud Solutions, and supporting technologies. Our consultants will be responsible for delivering implementations of Oracle Account Reconciliation Cloud Service (ARCS) and Financial Consolidation \& Close Cloud Service (FCCS) for Peloton clients. As a team member on your projects, you will be gathering requirements from client team members, including C\-level executives, and delivering solutions.
   

  

 The right candidates will possess an eagerness to partner with business leaders to develop unique and innovative solutions that result in real business results. Chosen candidates will have the opportunity to be involved in a variety of team\-based projects throughout the project lifecycle such as requirements Peloton \|Job Description Page 1 PCG Job Description gathering, process re\-engineering, solution design, implementation, and delivery. Peloton also places a high value on internal contributions through the support and development of the firm and its team members.
   

  

 This role requires working IST hours (5:30 PM to 2:30 AM) and a minimum of 15\+ years of relevant experience. Candidates based in Hyderabad or Bangalore are preferred, as these are our primary hiring locations.
   

  

 We are seeking an experienced and client\-focused Manager to lead Oracle Supply Chain Management (SCM) support operations for global clients. The ideal candidate should possess strong Oracle SCM functional expertise, leadership capabilities, excellent client\-facing skills, and hands\-on experience in managing support delivery in a global onsite/offshore model.
   

  

 This role requires close collaboration with clients, internal functional and technical teams, and Oracle Support to ensure high\-quality service delivery, SLA adherence, issue resolution, and continuous process improvement. The candidate is expected to work both as a manager and an individual contributor by actively supporting critical SCM tickets while guiding the team.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* 14\+ years of experience working with Oracle SCM modules.
* Lead and manage Oracle SCM support operations, ensuring tickets are resolved within SLA timelines.
* Closely work with SCM consultants and provide guidance on troubleshooting, setups, issue resolution, and client requirements.
* Act as the primary point of contact for SCM support delivery and client communications.
* Proactively manage SCM\-related escalations and drive issues to closure.
* Participate in client calls to understand requirements and resolve complex production issues.
* Work hands\-on on support tickets in addition to managing the SCM support team.
* Collaborate with technical teams and Oracle Support to resolve complex functional and technical issues.
* Oversee Quarterly Oracle release testing, regression testing, and deployment readiness activities.
* Conduct internal knowledge\-sharing and training sessions for the SCM team.
* Support process improvements, documentation, and operational governance activities.
* Work primarily in EST business hours and remain flexible to support CST/PST time zones and weekend activities as needed.


**Required Experience \& Skills**
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Technology, Supply Chain, Information Systems, or related field.
* 8\+ years of hands\-on experience in Oracle SCM Cloud (Fusion) implementation or support engagements.
* Strong functional expertise in at least three of the following modules:
* Costing
* Manufacturing
* Planning
* Order Management
* Strong understanding of Supply Chain business processes and Oracle SCM functional flows.
* Experience in Oracle SCM production support and/or end\-to\-end implementations.
* Excellent client\-facing, communication, analytical, and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to independently manage and resolve complex functional issues.
* Experience working in global onsite/offshore support models.
* Demonstrated leadership skills with the ability to mentor and guide teams.


**Additional Desired Skills**
* Experience with additional Oracle SCM modules.
* Oracle SCM Cloud certifications.
* Experience working in AMS/Managed services support engagements.

Actual compensation is influenced by a variety of factors including but not limited to skills, experience, qualifications, business needs, and geographic location. Peloton also offers bonus opportunities and a comprehensive benefits package including:
   

  

* Competitive base salary with performance\-based bonus
* Vacation, Leave, and Holiday pay
* Annual Health Wallet
* Group Medical Insurance
* Group Term Accident \& Life Insurance
* Paid holidays and PTO


*Peloton Group is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.*

description:
**Company Description**
 Wise is a global technology company, building the best way to move and manage the world’s money.
   

  

**Min fees. Max ease. Full speed.**
 Whether people and businesses are sending money to another country, spending abroad, or making and receiving international payments, Wise is on a mission to make their lives easier and save them money.
   

  

 As part of our team, you will be helping us create an entirely new network for the world's money.
   

  

**For everyone, everywhere.**
**Job Description**
 More about
 **our mission** 
 and
 **what we offer** 
 .
   

  

 As the Team Lead for KYC Operations on our newly established Deactivations Team, you will be at the forefront of strengthening Wise's commitment to regulatory compliance and protecting our financial ecosystem. Your mission is to build and guide a team of senior analysts who will become the authority in enhanced due diligence (EDD) and masters of risk assessment. You will lead your team who investigate complex KYC cases, empowering them with the duty to guarantee that every decision is compliant and accurate. It's a team that delivers justice and upholds our integrity when it matters the most.
   

  

 As this is a newly formed team at Wise, you won't just be following established guidelines \- you'll be a primary architect in their creation. You will lead the effort to shape the team's processes, enhance its tools, and develop its operational strategy. Your leadership, insights, and the feedback from your team will be crucial in building this function from the ground up.
   

  

 This is a unique opportunity for a sharp, inspiring leader who excels in high\-pressure situations and has a passion for developing expert investigators. If you are eager to build a team of subject matter experts in the comprehensive KYC/FinCrime arena and seek a position where your leadership will significantly influence our clients, enhance our reputation, and mentor the next wave of talent —then this opportunity is perfect for you.
   

  

**Job Responsibilities**
* Team Leadership Lead by example and drive a customer focused mindset across your team. Promote a culture of ownership and accountability. Build high\-performing teams that value knowledge sharing and continuous learning.
* People management Coach and develop a strong team of KYC Analysts. Come up with initiatives to help your team to grow their skills, behaviours, and competencies. Design and manage development plans on identified opportunities. Conducts career map check\-ins and makes recommendations for promotions, salary raises, and other decisions.
* Operational management Identify and propose opportunities for process improvements. Collaborate with central functions and other operational teams as needed to increase operational efficiency. Provide guidance and support on complex, high\-risk cases and escalations, which may include acting as a direct point of contact for customers via email, phone, or video call during sensitive inquiries, interviews, or escalations.
* Performance management Measure team KPIs and ensure performance targets and quality standards are met while maintaining focus on customer experience. Conduct regular one on one coaching sessions, usually on a weekly or biweekly basis. Run team meetings to ensure that your team is kept up to date with the latest information, share best practices and enhance overall team spirit.
* Expertise Sharing Be a subject matter expert in your area with the ability to train and coach your team on operational topics. Maintain a good understanding of our regulatory obligations, internal policies, and applying a risk\-based approach to deterring and preventing money laundering and financial crime. Able to perform deep dives, understand root causes of problematic cases and propose solutions to senior leadership.
* Planning and execution Ensure key performance indicators are being met and provide insights to other stakeholders. Take full accountability in delivering your own initiatives and making sure your team is making progress on their goals.
* Stakeholder management and communication Collaborate closely with your stakeholders ensuring clear communication and coordination of actions. You communicate mindfully and professionally while choosing the right formats and platforms to convey your message to a wider audience in a timely manner. Your initiatives and reports are well documented and it has a clear scope that includes potential impact in different areas.
* Quality assurance and control Implement and maintain a robust quality assurance framework for your team. Conduct regular checks and reviews of your team’s casework to ensure accuracy, consistency, and adherence to the highest standards of our policies and regulatory obligations. Provide targeted coaching and constructive feedback based on quality findings to drive continuous improvement. Analyse quality metrics to identify trends, address root causes of errors, and develop initiatives that enhance the team's overall performance and mitigate risk.


 Additional Information
   

  

 For everyone, everywhere. We're people building money without borders — without judgement or prejudice, too. We believe teams are strongest when they are diverse, equitable and inclusive.
   

  

 We're proud to have a truly international team, and we celebrate our differences.
   

  

 Inclusive teams help us live our values and make sure every Wiser feels respected, empowered to contribute towards our mission and able to progress in their careers.
   

  

 If you want to find out more about what it's like to work at Wise visit Wise.Jobs.
   

  

 Keep up to date with life at Wise by following us on LinkedIn and Instagram.

title: National Sea Logistics Reefer Manager
description:
**It's more than a job**
 As a member of the Freight Forwarding team Kuehne\+Nagel, you will play a key role in transporting goods, optimising processes, and fulfilling our customers' promises. And by transporting medicines, toys and important machine parts, you are not only delivering goods, you are making small and big moments possible for people all around the world. At Kuehne\+Nagel, our contribution counts in more ways than we imagine.
   

  

 ‎
   

  

 You will be part of our Sea Logistics Team to add your expertise \+ skills to the delivery of Customer \+ Product Excellence.
   

  

 Your primary objective is to drive \+ grow the reefer product by developing a strategy to gain \+ retain customers.
   

  

**How you create impact**
* To ensure your local product strategy aligns with the regional strategy \+ fits the local market.
* To build a local operational structure with reefer dedication within the customer \+ operational care locations (CCL \+ OCC) that creates \+ maintains reefer expertise, aiming for zero operational failures for temperature sensitive cargo.
* To ensure profitability across the profit \+ loss statement (P\+L), proactively following up on discrepancies.
* To manage local carrier relationships; ensuring access to appropriate escalation channels.
* To take the lead in local reefer pricing in coordination with the regional reefer trade manager.
* To build a reefer development team and support the KAM team and field sales where needed.
* To take the lead in setting up or maintaining a GxP Pharma branch to ensure operational excellence for pharmaceutical clients where demand exists.
* To provide regular reefer training.


**What we would like you to bring**
* 10\+ years of experience in Sea Logistics / Ocean Freight, with strong Reefer exposure.
* Proven Business Development experience in Reefer, Perishables, and/or Healthcare/Pharma.
* Strong experience in customer acquisition, retention, and revenue growth.
* Hands\-on P\&L and profitability management experience.
* Strong ocean carrier management, including pricing, negotiations, and capacity.
* Experience leading and developing sales/product teams.
* Strong relationships with key customers, KAMs, and field sales teams.
* Good knowledge of Reefer operations and cold\-chain logistics.
* Ability to develop and execute a Pan\-India Reefer strategy.


**What's in it for you**
* Global Exposure: Step into a world of international opportunities with a presence in 100\+ countries.
* People\-Centric Culture: Join a team where your voice matters and people genuinely care.
* Learning \& Development: Grow with us personally and professionally through world\-class training and career pathways.
* Innovation \& Sustainability: Be part of a future\-focused company driving real change in logistics and the planet.
* Rewards \& Recognition: Get rewarded for your passion, performance, and potential.
* Stability with Agility: Enjoy the best of both worlds a trusted global brand with a startup spirit.


**Who we are**
 Logistics shapes everyday life \- from the goods we consume to the healthcare we rely on. At Kuehne\+Nagel, your work goes beyond logistics; it enables both ordinary and special moments in the lives of people around the world.
   

  

 As a global leader with a strong heritage and a vision to move the world forward, we offer a safe, stable environment where your career can make a real difference. Whether we help deliver life\-saving medicines, develop sustainable transportation solutions or support our local communities, your career will contribute to more than you can imagine.
   

  

 We kindly advise that placement agencies refrain from submitting unsolicited profiles. Any submissions of candidates without prior signed agreement will be considered our property and no fees will be paid.

description:
**About Business**
**JOB DESCRIPTION**
**Adani Group** 
 : Adani Group is a diversified organisation in India comprising 10 publicly traded companies. It has created a world class logistics and utility infrastructure portfolio that has a pan\-India presence. Adani Group is headquartered in Ahmedabad, in the state of Gujarat, India. Over the years, Adani Group has positioned itself to be the market leader in its logistics and energy businesses focusing on large scale infrastructure development in India with O \& M practices benchmarked to global standards. With four IG rated businesses, it is the only Infrastructure Investment Grade issuer in India.
   

  

**Adani Airports Holding Limited** 
 : Adani Airports Holding Limited is reshaping the aviation landscape, transforming airports into dynamic hubs of connectivity, innovation, and service excellence. By prioritizing passenger experience, leveraging state\-of\-the\-art technology, and enhancing operational efficiency, we are redefining airport infrastructure across India. Our vision is to create world\-class airports that serve as gateways to regional development and global connectivity, positioning Adani Airports as a leader in the aviation sector with a focus on sustainable growth and community impact.
   

  

**Job Purpose:** 
 Executive \- Building Management Systems (BMS) is responsible for overseeing the engineering, maintenance, and operational management of all BMS systems within the airport. This includes ensuring the proper functioning, reliability, and performance of systems such as HVAC, lighting, fire alarm systems, access control, and other integrated mechanical, electrical, and civil systems that are controlled through BMS. The role ensures preventive and corrective maintenance, and manage troubleshooting for BMS\-related issues across airport facilities.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**BMS System Engineering \& Maintenance:**
 Lead the engineering, installation, commissioning, and maintenance of BMS systems, ensuring that they operate efficiently, reliably, and in compliance with airport standards.
   

  

 Oversee the day\-to\-day operation of BMS infrastructure, including HVAC, lighting, electrical systems, fire alarm systems, and access controls, ensuring their seamless integration with other airport systems.
   

  

 Ensure continuous monitoring, testing, and updating of BMS systems to maintain optimal performance levels across all facilities.
   

  

 Develop and execute maintenance schedules for BMS systems, ensuring proper preventive maintenance and minimal downtime.
   

  

**Troubleshooting And Fault Resolution**
 Lead troubleshooting efforts in case of system failures, quickly diagnosing faults within BMS\-related systems and resolving issues with minimal disruption to airport operations.
   

  

 Coordinate with engineering teams to repair or replace faulty components of BMS systems, ensuring efficient and timely resolutions.
   

  

 Implement diagnostic tools and technologies to identify potential issues before they impact the operations of the airport.
   

  

**Energy Efficiency And Sustainability**
 Monitor and optimize energy consumption across airport facilities by utilizing BMS for HVAC systems, lighting, and electrical load management.
   

  

 Implement energy\-saving initiatives through BMS systems, ensuring energy optimization and contributing to the airport’s sustainability goals.
   

  

 Evaluate the performance of BMS systems in managing energy usage, recommending improvements for greater cost savings and environmental benefits.
   

  

**Safety And Regulatory Compliance**
 Ensure that all BMS systems comply with airport\-specific safety standards, industry regulations, and local environmental health and safety guidelines.
   

  

 Conduct regular safety audits and inspections on BMS\-related systems, ensuring proper documentation and compliance with safety standards such as fire safety, electrical safety, and hazard control.
   

  

 Assist in the development and updating of Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for BMS operation and maintenance to ensure a safe environment for all stakeholders.
   

  

**Budget Planning \& Forecasting**
 Develop and manage the annual budget for BMS operations, including system maintenance, upgrades, energy\-saving initiatives, and staffing.
   

  

 Prepare detailed budget forecasts, considering historical data, upcoming projects, and planned system enhancements to ensure adequate financial planning.
   

  

**BMS Performance Monitoring**
 Lead the monitoring of BMS data for system performance, energy usage, and operational efficiency, utilizing system dashboards and reports.
   

  

 Analyze system data to detect performance trends and inefficiencies, implementing corrective measures as necessary.
   

  

 Develop and track key performance indicators (KPIs) related to BMS system uptime, reliability, and energy consumption to ensure continuous improvement.
   

  

**Vendor And Contractor Management**
 Oversee relationships with third\-party vendors and contractors responsible for BMS system components or services, ensuring high\-quality service delivery and compliance with contractual obligations.
   

  

 Coordinate with vendors for the timely procurement of equipment, materials, and parts required for the maintenance and repair of BMS systems.
   

  

 Manage vendor service level agreements (SLAs) and ensure that maintenance and repair activities are performed within specified time frames and quality standards.
   

  

**Team Leadership And Development**
 Lead and supervise the BMS engineering and maintenance team, providing guidance, training, and mentorship to junior engineers and technicians.
   

  

 Develop and implement training programs to improve the technical skills and knowledge of the BMS team.
   

  

 Ensure proper documentation of maintenance activities and work orders, ensuring that team members follow industry best practices and safety guidelines.
   

  

**Project Management And System Upgrades**
 Lead BMS system upgrade projects, including design, installation, and commissioning, ensuring alignment with airport’s engineering objectives and timelines.
   

  

 Plan and manage engineering projects related to BMS integration with other airport systems, ensuring minimal disruption to ongoing operations during implementation.
   

  

 Assist in evaluating and selecting new BMS technologies and tools to enhance operational capabilities.
   

  

**Reporting And Documentation**
 Provide regular reports on the status and performance of BMS systems, including energy usage, maintenance activities, and system health.
   

  

 Maintain detailed records of system configurations, maintenance logs, troubleshooting reports, and compliance audits to ensure transparency and accountability.
   

  

 Document system updates, troubleshooting efforts, and any changes to BMS configurations, ensuring all data is current and easily accessible for future reference.
   

  

**Key Stakeholders \- Internal**
 Head \- Engineering Services
   

  

 Maintenance Team
   

  

 Facility Management Team
   

  

 Operations Team
   

  

 Procurement Team
   

  

 Safety and Compliance Team
   

  

 Project Management Team
   

  

 IT Support Team
   

  

**Key Stakeholders \- External**
 Clients/Building Owners
   

  

 Contractors and Subcontractors
   

  

 Equipment Vendors and Suppliers
   

  

 Regulatory Authorities
   

  

 Third\-Party Auditors
   

  

 Consultants and Design Engineers
   

  

 Service Providers for System Upgrades and Maintenance
   

  

**Qualifications**
**Educational Qualifications:**
 Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field
   

  

 Certification in Building Management Systems (BMS) or similar, such as from the Building Controls Industry Association (BCIA) or equivalent
   

  

 Additional certifications in HVAC, electrical systems, or energy management are a plus
   

  

 Professional engineering license (depending on the country/region)
   

  

**Work Experience**
 10\+ years of experience working with BMS systems, including hands\-on installation, commissioning, and troubleshooting
   

  

 Proven experience in managing teams and leading projects within the BMS or building automation industry
   

  

 Strong background in working with control systems, HVAC, lighting, and energy management solutions
   

  

 Experience collaborating with contractors, clients, and other engineering teams on large\-scale building projects
   

  

 Familiarity with industry regulations, safety standards, and energy efficiency guidelines

Skill required: Talent Development - Learning Delivery Operations

 Designation: Instructor Associate Manager

 Qualifications: Any Graduation 

 Years of Experience: 10 to 14 years 

 What would you do 
 Deliver high-impact virtual leadership and communication training for employees of a US-based logistics company. This is a delivery-focused learning partner role, not an end-to-end course builder. The ideal candidate will:
 Conceptualize the right delivery approach for leadership and non-technical topics
 Advise on program structure and flow to maximize participant impact
 Engage confidently with senior client audiences while collaborating with the central design team
 Conduct comprehensive needs analysis and drive continuous improvement measurement
 Maintain strong customer relationships and demonstrate expertise through recognized LDP certifications
This role emphasizes world-class virtual delivery, customer partnership, and data-driven improvementleveraging pre-built curriculum and design support from the central team.
Talent Development involves creating and implementing programs to enhance employees skills and career growth. This includes training, mentoring, and performance management. The goal is to help employees reach their full potential and contribute effectively to the organization. Responsibilities also include identifying skill gaps and developing strategies to address them. This role is essential for fostering a skilled and motivated workforce.
Ensure successful delivery of learning solutions and review their effectiveness and applicability.

 What are we looking for 
 5-10 years of proven experience delivering leadership and communication training, preferably with US client exposure and scalable virtual delivery models.
 Minimum ONE recognized LDP certification (MBTI-trained facilitator, Hogan certified, DDI trained, CliftonStrengths certified, Five Behaviors facilitator, or equivalent industry-standard credential demonstrating specialized expertise).
 Demonstrated experience conducting needs analysis for training programs, including learner personas, organizational context assessment, and success metric definition.
 Multiple LDP certifications (e.g., MBTI + Hogan + CliftonStrengths combination) demonstrating depth of expertise.
 Experience with logistics-specific leadership challenges, frontline team motivation, operational decision-making, and supply chain context.
 Expertise in adaptive, blended, and personalized learning models; experience with learning technology and adaptive platforms.
 Track record of scaling training programs from pilot to enterprise level; experience managing multiple concurrent cohorts.
 Speaking experience at industry conferences, webinars, or training forums.
 Background in organizational development, change management, or executive coaching.

Essential Skills Competencies
1. Needs Analysis Discovery - Ability to conduct structured interviews, design assessment frameworks, analyze organizational contexts, and translate insights into delivery design.
2. Persona Development Adaptation - Skill in creating learner personas, adapting communication style, and customizing examples and activities based on audience profiles.
3. Measurement Data Analysis - Comfort with training metrics, survey design, data interpretation, and translating findings into recommendations.
4. Continuous Improvement Mindset - Proactive approach to identifying enhancement opportunities, iterating on delivery, and documenting learnings for scaling.
5. Customer Liaison Stakeholder Management - Comfort presenting to C-suite, gathering feedback, managing expectations, and building collaborative partnerships.
6. Virtual Facilitation Excellence - Mastery of virtual delivery techniques, participant engagement in distributed settings, time zone flexibility, and technical proficiency.
7. LDP Framework Expertise - Deep knowledge of behavioral, personality, or emotional intelligence assessment models; ability to integrate frameworks into training design and coaching. 

 Roles and Responsibilities: 
 Training Delivery Content Customization Conduct engaging, interactive virtual sessions on leadership and communication skills tailored for US logistics professionals (frontline supervisors to senior leaders). Perform comprehensive pre-training needs analysis within 2 weeks of engagement kickoff to identify skill gaps, learner personas, organizational context, and delivery readiness. Customize training delivery and examples to address core logistics leadership topics: team collaboration, communication, problem-solving, technology adaptability, resilience in operational disruptions. Cover relevant leadership skills from industry-recognized Leadership Development Programs (LDPs): self-awareness, team performance acceleration, effective feedback, resilience, trust-building, leading with authenticity in complex environments. Leverage Training-as-a-Service (TaaS) principles for scalable, interactive virtual training aligned with US business hours and operational realities.Persona-Based Delivery Adaptation Conduct participant persona analysis (frontline supervisors, middle managers, senior leaders) to understand diverse learning needs, communication preferences, operational challenges, and success drivers. Adapt delivery style, examples, case studies, and facilitation methods based on persona-specific requirements and organizational culture. Tailor pace, interaction methods, and breakout room activities to match learner profiles (e.g., high-pressure operational leaders vs. strategic planning roles). Provide persona-specific feedback and coaching to ensure relevance and on-the-job application for participant roles.LDP Expertise Professional Mastery Demonstrate mastery of at least one recognized Leadership Development Program framework (Hogan, DDI, CliftonStrengths, MBTI, Five Behaviors of a Cohesive Team, or equivalent). Apply personality, behavioral, and emotional intelligence assessment frameworks to training design and participant coaching. Integrate LDP frameworks into 100% of training modules as a performance expectation.

 Qualification Any Graduation

This is an ideal first role for a fresh MBA graduate who wants exposure to how a fast\-scaling product organisation actually runs — you'll learn by doing, with real ownership from day one.
 



 You will:
 


* Support the P\&E rhythm of business — helping coordinate roadmap reviews, sprint planning, launch readiness, post\-launch retrospectives, and QBRs — and help build the operating cadence that keeps the product organisation structured and predictable.
* Help track the product metrics that matter: activation, adoption, retention, expansion, and their leading indicators. Assist in building out the "product landing" framework — a structured post\-launch process that ensures new features are actually adopted and generate learnings for the next iteration.
* Support the product\-level analysis of pricing and packaging — how capabilities are bundled, how value is communicated at each tier, and how new AI modules affect the overall commercial model.
* Assist Finance and Sales on pricing changes — building models of customer impact and helping structure the internal and external communication around pricing evolution.
* Help develop ROI frameworks and value metrics for each product area, which Marketing and Sales can use in positioning and commercial conversations.
* Support the sales enablement process — working with Sales and Marketing to help set targets, build plans, and track tactics that drive pipeline generation, CSAT, and adoption.
* Help build and maintain competitive intelligence systems that give product leaders an up\-to\-date view of the market landscape.



**What We're Looking For**

 .

* Strong analytical and structured problem\-solving skills, with comfort working with data to build frameworks, dashboards, and business cases.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to structure and present ideas clearly to cross\-functional stakeholders.
* High ownership mindset, intellectual curiosity, and comfort operating with ambiguity — the kind of environment typical of an early\-stage, fast\-scaling product organisation.
* Interest in enterprise SaaS / IT management products (RMM, PSA, MDM, Endpoint management, Ticketing systems) and emerging AI technologies is a plus.
* Bachelor's degree required, followed by a full\-time MBA from a top\-tier B\-school.

**About Us**
 At Bank of America, we are guided by a common purpose to help make financial lives better through the power of every connection. We do this by driving Responsible Growth and delivering for our clients, teammates, communities and shareholders every day.
   

  

 Being a Great Place to Work and providing a culture of caring is core to how we drive Responsible Growth. We are intentional about fostering an inclusive workplace where every teammate has the opportunity to succeed, build a career and contribute to our shared success. This includes attracting and developing exceptional talent, recognizing and rewarding performance, and supporting our teammates’ physical, emotional, and financial wellness through affordable, competitive and flexible benefits.
   

  

 We value the unique perspectives individuals bring from all backgrounds and career paths \- whether shaped by military service, community college education, or a wide range of work and life experiences. These journeys foster resilience, leadership and innovation, strengthening our workforce and positively impact the communities we serve.
   

  

 Bank of America is committed to an in\-office culture that supports collaboration, engagement, and career development. Our approach includes clear in\-office expectations, while providing an appropriate level of flexibility based on role\-specific responsibilities and business needs.

The team is also responsible for reporting and governance across all valuation processes. Additionally, the team works on a number of regulatory deliverables related to valuations and drives the overall valuation control automation agenda in partnership with Technology and other stakeholders.
   

  

 The team works closely with front office, middle office, traders, business finance controllers, market risk, quantitative risk and technology teams to drive the control agenda across the business.
   

  

**Job Description\***
 We are looking to hire a seasoned leader in the Global Valuations Group to project manage number of regulatory deliverables for GM \& GCIB Finance organization. The person will be responsible for planning of regulatory engagement through the cycle from early notification to remediation phases. They will be required to manage stakeholders from different divisions within the bank to ensure that right responsibilities are allocated to right teams and the teams deliver on those in a timely fashion. They will be helping the team put together regulatory submissions, will track progress and milestones, escalate risks as needed and facilitate issue resolution.
   

  

 Given this role will be part of the valuations group and will involve interactions with senior management of technical functions, we need the person to have a deep understanding of all regulatory guidelines (like CCAR stress testing, Prudential Valuation guidelines from a PRA and ECB perspective, ICAAP etc.). Additionally, they should also have a good knowledge of financial products and their valuations. Ideally, this role will best suit a person who has already been managing such technical regulatory projects for multiple years.

**Job Description Summary**
 Job Summary
   

  

 The Laboratory Manager is responsible for overseeing all laboratory sections, including Serology, Bacteriology, Media Preparation, and PCR, ensuring that all samples are processed and tested accurately, efficiently, and within agreed timelines. The role is responsible for implementing and maintaining testing protocols in line with approved quality standards while continuously seeking opportunities to improve efficiency and consistency of the techniques wherever possible.
   

  

 The position also plays a critical role in monitoring Salmonella and other pathogens to support the health status of Aviagen operations and the smooth running of the business. The incumbent is expected to operate with a thorough understanding of and compliance with company Biosecurity, Safety, and Animal Welfare policies and procedures.
   

  

**Job Description**
**POSITION : LABORATORY MANAGER**
**Key Responsibilities**
 Manage the daily operations of the laboratory (Serology, Bacteriology, Media Preparation, and PCR) and ensure accurate, reliable, and timely test results. Ensure that all data are maintained accurately and timely in accordance with Aviagen standards and process Monitor Salmonella and other pathogens and provide timely diagnostic support and review laboratory results and communicate deviations to the internal veterinary team for further action. Manage laboratory personnel, including recruitment, onboarding, performance management, communication, training, competency assessment and employee development to ensure that the lab is resourced with competent and motivated staff. Coordinate trainings for new and existing staffs, including equipment operation, laboratory safety procedures, and refresher training programmes and maintain appropriate documentation of all trainings and competency assessments. Ensure the working practices in the laboratory meet appropriate standards of hygiene, health and safety. Prepare and submit periodic reports and annual laboratory performance reports. Plan and manage the laboratory budget, identifying opportunities for cost optimisation and continuous improvement. Planning and procuring required materials through established procurement process of the organisation and ensure the timely availability of laboratory consumables, reagents, and equipment to ensure uninterrupted operations Establish and maintain close liaison with appropriate researchers and diagnostic laboratories. Maintain contact with State Regulatory personnel and compliance with all applicable regulations. Preparing annual reports, and successful completion and continuation of NABL accreditation. Ensure that all laboratory instruments and equipment, including safety equipment such as eyewash stations and safety showers, are functioning properly and maintained in accordance with established procedures. Coordinate with relevant teams to ensure timely maintenance, calibration, and repair of laboratory equipment.
   

  

**Personal Requirements For The Role**

**Description**
 AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.
   

  

 You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

**About You**
 You will be a proven manager with experience managing teams of high performers. You will have the ability to refine and develop processes to optimize operational excellence in every area of your role. You will be able to drive performance levels to achieve the pace at which we build and operate Data Centers in India for Amazon Data Services India Private Limited (“ADSIPL”). You will have previous experience in Data Centers, either building or managing (or both) along with exposure to developing great relationships with both internal teams and external vendors.
   

  

 You will also have a passion for technology along with a desire to be the best at your job every day!
   

  

**About The Role**
 As a Data Center Manager in ADSIPL, you will get to manage the world’s largest Cloud Computing Infrastructure in India. We encounter interesting, challenging \& complex problems every day, being a technical manager in ADSIPL means that you can innovate to solve these issues and help drive Operations Excellence in all areas of your role.
   

  

 Your day job at ADSIPL will include (but not limited to):
   

  

* Managing and developing teams of engineers, providing both technical and leadership expertise and ensuring highest levels of performance.
* Maintaining existing co\-located and in\-house Data Centers
* Helping build and bring online new Data Centers
* Constantly improving all our processes and procedures. We believe there is nothing we cannot improve
* Assisting \& managing relationships with external vendors \& contractors
* Liaising with internal teams \& management groups
* Ensuring we adhere to and exceed local Health \& Safety standards in all our Data Centers
* Creating and maintaining metrics on all aspects of our Data Centers and utilizing those metrics to drive positive changes
* Assisting in implementing service methodologies including incident management, problem management, change management, capacity management, etc.


 What are we looking for in a successful AWS Returner Data Centre Manager (DCM) candidate along with the technical knowledge and experience.
   

  

 People Management.
   

  

 As a successful candidate you will have managed a team of at least 5 individuals, over a period of at least 3 years. You will be able to demonstrate how you have continued to improve performance of an existing team along with displaying skills in creating or growing a team. Experience managing both high \& low performing employees will be of advantage along with conflict management.
   

  

 Incident Management.
   

  

 You will have a lot of experience dealing with high severity situations, show a clear understanding of the wider blast implications of any issue/outage and potential consequences of differing outcome scenarios. You will also have experience in Change Management \& Fault Management.
   

  

 Vendor Management.
   

  

 An Amazon, individual has to deal with vendors, contractors \& security companies. You will be able to prove you have experience dealing with external vendors and be able to display incidents of both problem \& conflict management when dealing with same.
   

  

 Process Improvement.
   

  

 You will be able to demonstrate an ability of taking both a good working process \& a bad process and improving. You will have experience in processes mapping, implementing remediation steps and how this affected the overall business you were working in. Experience in Kaizen/Lean/Six Sigma is preferable
   

  

 Health \& Safety.
   

  

 Health \& Safety should be at the forefront of every manager's mind. Managers should be able to positively influence the Safety culture of the Data Center organization.
   

  

**About The Team**
 About AWS
   

  

 Diverse Experiences
   

  

 Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

 Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. title: Associate Director- Operation
description:
About Loadshare LoadShare is one of India’s most innovative and resilient logistics platforms, transforming how goods move across the country. Founded in 2017, we’ve grown to become a pan-India, multi-category last-mile network with a unique presence in both Tier 1 metros and deep Tier 2/3 towns.  What sets us apart:  Scale with depth: We handle ~550K deliveries/day across food, e-commerce (B2C), B2B retail, and digital commerce, powered by a 30,000+ rider network.  Strong financials, stronger ambition: With 800+ Cr in FY26 revenue and support from global investors (Tiger Global, Matrix, BII, Stellaris, BeeNext), we have a long runway and a path to profitability.  Dual-engine model: We not only operate India’s most flexible last-mile delivery network, but also license our in-house logistics tech platform that processes an additional 20 lakh orders/day — one of the few in India to enable asset cross-utilization across verticals.  Strong Tech: We are in a unique position to cross-utilize the delivery boys across different earning opportunities matching the peaks of various use-cases throughout the day. (ex: grocery peaks at 6-8 am, while bike taxi peaks from 8 to 10 am, etc). In addition to this, our supply chain SaaS platforms power over 1M+ shipments per day. Strategic partner to India’s digital economy: We work with every major digital commerce player (ecomm, quick commerce, food, mobility) , and are expanding wallet share and capabilities within existing giants while co-creating new models with emerging platforms and brands.  Built to scale profitably: We’re not chasing GMV at all costs. We’re building the most capital-efficient, tech-enabled logistics engine in the country. We’re now building for our next phase: a 5X scale-up over the next 5 years, anchored in sharper client focus, deeper solutions, and new growth engines.  Founders/ Founding team:  Raghu Talluri (CEO) - Formerly at Myntra, McKinsey  Pramod Nair (CTO) - Formerly at Freecharge, Snapdeal, MartMobi  Rakib Ahmed (Co Founder, Head EComm/ Trucking/Warehousing)- Formerly at ICICI Prudential, Co founder Lunate Eco  
 Roles and Responsibilities 
 Job Responsibilities:  Hyperlocal/Quick-Commerce Network Expansion:  Launch and scale the operations across cities from scratch including hub setup, staffing, and training.  Plan and execute city-level ramp-ups, pilot projects, and cost modeling exercises.  Operational Excellence:  Ensure adherence to SLAs and quality metrics (GM/CM%, RTO, etc.).  Drive performance audits and implement SOPs to optimize cost-per-order and improve customer experience.  Cost Strategy & Profitability:  Develop and own the P&L for assigned zones; implement cost-effective strategies in manpower, infra, and routing.  Partner with finance to ensure accurate reconciliation, cash management, and profitability at the micro-hub level.  Team Management & Grooming:  Hire, train, and groom delivery personnel and on-ground operation leads via structured OJT and performance tracking mechanisms.  Drive a high-performance culture through regular reviews, productivity benchmarks, and upskilling.  Stakeholder Management:  Coordinate closely with client partners to align on daily ops, performance expectations, and escalation handling.  Support inter-city ops alignment, especially in expanding geographies.  Experience: 3–8 years in hyperlocal/Quick-commerce logistics; must have led operations and 3P logistics in a leadership role.  Industry Exposure: Hyperlocal delivery, ecommerce logistics, food/grocery delivery, or quick commerce.  Skill Set:   Strong command over ground operations and supply chain mechanics (Last Mile). Analytical mindset with a focus on cost vs. performance.  Excellent team handling, stakeholder engagement, and communication skills.

 About DHL Blue Dart Express India:
   

  

 Blue Dart Express Limited, a listed company, is a leader in courier, integrated air express package distribution, and eCommerce in South Asia, offering a wide range of logistics solutions. Founded in 1983, it is recognised for reliable, time\-bound, and secure delivery services across 55,000\+ locations in India as well as internationally. Its competencies span across evaluation and contracting, planning and transition, delivery and execution, and specific service capabilities. We pride ourselves on innovation, digitalization, service excellence, and creating long\-term partnerships with our clients, enabling businesses to thrive in the fast\-paced logistics environment and ever\-evolving supply\-chains. It wholly\-owns India’s only scheduled air cargo airline, Blue Dart Aviation Limited, since May 1994, and the Concorde Air Logistics Limited, a transport, storage, and communications business, since May 2004\.
   

  

 Blue Dart Express Limited is a part of the DHL Group's DHL eCommerce division, leveraging this global logistics leader’s network across 220 countries and territories to provide comprehensive express and logistics solutions to our clients. Our robust network and unmatched infrastructure have positioned the Blue Dart brand as a key India\-grown logistics player with an unmatched and phenomenal global outreach rooted in the DHL brand of its majority shareholder.
   

  

 We are proud to be consistently ranked among India’s Top 100 Great Places to Work, combining it with DHL Group’s Top Employer certification. Being an Employer of Choice is not just a goal; it’s a fundamental part of who we are, committed to creating a workplace where people are valued, empowered, and wear the sobriquet “Blue Darter” with honour.
   

  

 If you are looking to join a purpose\-led, people\-first, company that shapes India’s supply\-chains with integrity and safety, Blue Dart is where you belong. Blue Dart offers competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits, access to cross\-functional, succession planning and global career paths, and strong culture of recognition.
   

  

 Position Overview:
   

  

 The PUD Manager is responsible for leading the end\-to\-end operations of one or more Pickup \& Delivery Units (PUDs), ensuring safe, timely and cost\-effective execution of first\-mile pickup, last\-mile delivery and customer service operations. The role is accountable for operational performance, fleet readiness, workforce productivity, customer satisfaction and service quality across the assigned locations.
   

  

 Reporting to the Regional PUD Manager, the incumbent leads frontline operational teams, coordinates with cross\-functional stakeholders and transport partners, and ensures seamless integration of pickup, delivery and hub operations. The role drives operational discipline, revenue assurance, people capability and continuous improvement while ensuring compliance with organisational standards and customer commitments.
   

  

 Job Purpose:
   

  

 To lead and manage the operations of assigned Pickup \& Delivery Units by delivering operational excellence, customer service, workforce productivity, fleet optimisation and revenue assurance while ensuring safe, compliant and profitable first\-mile and last\-mile operations aligned with Blue Dart's service standards.
   

  

 Key Roles \& Responsibilities:
   

  

 PUD Operations Leadership
   

  

  

* Lead the overall operations of the assigned PUD(s), ensuring consistent achievement of operational, service and business objectives.
* Drive operational planning and execution across pickup, delivery and customer service activities.
* Ensure adherence to operational workflows, Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and service commitments.
* Monitor daily operational performance and implement timely corrective actions to address service gaps.
* Ensure operational readiness of manpower, fleet and infrastructure to support business requirements.


 Pickup \& Delivery Operations
   

  

  

* Manage first\-mile pickup and last\-mile delivery operations to achieve committed service levels and customer expectations.
* Monitor daily pickup schedules, delivery performance and route execution to maximise operational efficiency.
* Ensure timely processing, dispatch and movement of shipments through seamless coordination with hubs and service centres.
* Drive reduction in missed pickups, delivery exceptions, return\-to\-origin (RTO) cases and operational delays.
* Monitor shipment visibility and ensure timely closure of operational exceptions.


 Customer Service \& Service Quality
   

  

  

* Drive customer service excellence by ensuring adherence to pickup and delivery commitments.
* Partner with Customer Service teams to ensure timely resolution of customer complaints and service issues.
* Monitor customer feedback, operational performance and Net Promoter Score (NPS) trends to improve customer experience.
* Ensure timely communication and resolution of operational issues impacting customers.
* Support implementation of initiatives to improve customer satisfaction, service reliability and operational quality.


 Fleet, Route \& Resource Management
   

  

  

* Ensure optimum deployment and utilisation of fleet resources to support daily pickup and delivery operations.
* Coordinate with Fleet Operations teams and transport partners to ensure vehicle availability and route optimisation.
* Monitor route productivity, vehicle utilisation and operational efficiency across assigned PUDs.

WE ARE HIRINGAdmissions Sales \& Operations Manager
 



 🏢 Company: Dream Life Educational Services
 



 📍 Location: Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu
 



 💼 Work Mode: Full\-Time \| Work From Office
 



 👥 Reporting To: CEO \& Management
 



 🎓 Industry: Education \| College Admissions \| EdTech
 



  





 Compensation
 


* Fixed CTC: ₹3\.5–₹4\.2 LPA
* Performance\-Linked Incentives: Up to ₹3 LPA
* Total Earning Potential: ₹7\+ LPA
* Final compensation will depend on relevant experience, team\-handling capability, previous performance and interview assessment.



 About Dream Life Educational Services
 



 Dream Life Educational Services is a Coimbatore\-based education consultancy supporting students and parents with college selection, career counselling and admissions across Tamil Nadu and Bengaluru.
 



 As part of our 2027 expansion, we are looking for an experienced and performance\-driven Admissions Sales \& Operations Manager to lead our admissions, telecalling, counselling and office operations.
 



  





 Role Overview
 



 The Admissions Sales \& Operations Manager will be responsible for managing the company’s day\-to\-day admissions sales and operational activities.
 



 The selected candidate will work directly with the CEO and management and take ownership of the telecalling team, closing counsellors, CRM processes, lead management, recruitment support, training, performance monitoring and admission\-target achievement.
 



 This is a leadership position suitable for a candidate who can independently manage teams, establish processes and drive business growth.
 



  





 Key ResponsibilitiesSales and Admissions Management
 


* Manage the complete student\-admission process, from lead allocation to admission confirmation.
* Set daily, weekly and monthly targets for telecallers and closing counsellors.
* Monitor lead\-response time, follow\-ups, counselling quality and conversion rates.
* Support the team in handling difficult parent objections and high\-value admission closures.
* Ensure hot leads are transferred to closing counsellors without delay.
* Track admission documentation, fee payments and confirmation status.
* Develop and execute strategies to achieve monthly and annual admission targets.



 Team Management
 


* Manage telecallers, admission counsellors and other sales\-support employees.
* Conduct daily morning meetings and evening performance reviews.
* Monitor employee attendance, discipline, productivity and target achievement.
* Identify underperforming employees and implement coaching and improvement plans.
* Motivate the team and maintain a professional, target\-oriented work environment.
* Coordinate employee recruitment, onboarding, training and assessments.
* Support management in building and scaling the admissions team.



 CRM and Lead Management
 


* Manage lead allocation and follow\-up processes through LeadSquared or a similar CRM.
* Ensure every call, follow\-up and lead stage is updated accurately.
* Segregate leads based on course, location, interest level and admission readiness.
* Monitor missed follow\-ups, inactive leads and overdue tasks.
* Maintain accurate reports on leads, conversions, admissions and revenue.
* Ensure zero leakage of high\-potential leads.



 Operations Management
 


* Oversee day\-to\-day office and admissions operations.
* Coordinate with college admission teams and management representatives.
* Maintain updated information about colleges, courses, fees, hostels and admission procedures.
* Ensure the team has the required call scripts, comparison sheets and college information.
* Establish SOPs for admissions, follow\-ups, documentation and payment tracking.
* Coordinate with marketing, data, HR/admin and management teams.
* Handle student, parent and college\-related escalations professionally.
* Submit daily, weekly and monthly MIS reports to the CEO and management.



 Training and Quality Control
 


* Train telecallers and counsellors on courses, colleges, scripts, CRM and objection handling.
* Conduct mock calls, performance assessments and refresher training.
* Review call recordings and provide structured feedback.
* Improve call quality, counselling standards and team conversion ratios.
* Ensure consistent communication and service quality across the team.



 Required Qualifications
 


* Any Bachelor’s or Master’s degree.
* Minimum 3\+ years of experience in sales, admissions, counselling, business development or operations.
* Previous team\-handling experience is mandatory.
* Experience managing a team of 5–10 members is preferred.
* Strong knowledge of sales funnels, lead follow\-ups and admission closures.
* Hands\-on experience with CRM software, Excel or Google Sheets.
* Strong Tamil and English communication skills.
* Good leadership, negotiation, problem\-solving and decision\-making abilities.
* Ability to work independently and take responsibility for business outcomes.
* Must be comfortable working in a target\-driven environment.
* Must be willing to work full\-time from our Coimbatore office.



 Preferred Industry Background
 



 First preference will be given to candidates with experience in:
 


* EdTech companies
* College admission consultancies
* Education counselling organisations
* Coaching or training institutes
* University or college admissions departments
* Overseas education consultancies
* Target\-driven inside\-sales organisations



 Key Skills
 


* Team leadership and people management
* Admissions sales and counselling
* Telecalling\-team management
* CRM and lead\-funnel management
* Target planning and performance monitoring
* Parent objection handling
* Admission closing and negotiation
* Recruitment and employee training
* MIS reporting and data analysis
* Process development and operations management
* College relationship management
* Strong ownership and accountability



 Performance Areas
 



 The selected candidate will be evaluated based on:
 


* Team productivity and discipline
* CRM accuracy and process compliance
* Lead follow\-up completion
* Call quality and counselling standards
* Lead\-to\-admission conversion
* Monthly and annual admission targets
* Employee training and retention
* Reporting accuracy and operational efficiency
* Overall business growth



 Candidate Preference
 


* Immediate joiners or candidates with a short notice period will be preferred.

* Applicants must have genuine team\-management experience and a strong performance record.

 NOC steps in to resolve the issue and keeps all the stakeholders informed on the proceedings. Along with this tactical problem solving, NOC is also charged with understanding trends in network exceptions and then automating processes or proposing process changes to streamline operations. This second aspect involves network monitoring and significant analysis of network data. Overall, NOC plays a critical role in ensuring the smooth functioning of Amazon transportation and thereby has a direct impact on Amazon’s ability to serve its customers on time.
   

  

 Within NOC’s umbrella, resides a specific arm which manages Amazon Fresh, SSD \& Amazon Now (Quick commerce) businesses. GSF – Central Operations (GSF\-CO), part of the Network Operations Center (NOC), acts as the Command\-and\-Control center for the GSF operations in IN, SG and MENA. Team supports multiple lines of businesses such as (a) Amazon Fresh – i. Ultra\-Fast Fresh (UFF) \& ii. Hybrid 3P; (b) Sub\-Same Day (SSD) across last mile, first mile, distribution centers, Supply Chain and (c) Amazon Now AKA Project Tez which is the Quick Commerce arm of amazon.in. In Addition, GSF CO manages delivery operations of More Super and Hyper Market (MSM) located in T10\+ cities, remotely, where the scope includes order assignment, exception monitoring, COD reconciliation and BTO Scans. Apart from IN, GSF CO also supports Fresh, SSD \& Quick Commerce (QC) operations in AE \& SG geographies.

description:
About Loadshare LoadShare is one of India’s most innovative and resilient logistics platforms, transforming how goods move across the country. Founded in 2017, we’ve grown to become a pan-India, multi-category last-mile network with a unique presence in both Tier 1 metros and deep Tier 2/3 towns.  What sets us apart:  Scale with depth: We handle ~550K deliveries/day across food, e-commerce (B2C), B2B retail, and digital commerce, powered by a 30,000+ rider network.  Strong financials, stronger ambition: With 800+ Cr in FY26 revenue and support from global investors (Tiger Global, Matrix, BII, Stellaris, BeeNext), we have a long runway and a path to profitability.  Dual-engine model: We not only operate India’s most flexible last-mile delivery network, but also license our in-house logistics tech platform that processes an additional 20 lakh orders/day — one of the few in India to enable asset cross-utilization across verticals.  Strong Tech: We are in a unique position to cross-utilize the delivery boys across different earning opportunities matching the peaks of various use-cases throughout the day. (ex: grocery peaks at 6-8 am, while bike taxi peaks from 8 to 10 am, etc). In addition to this, our supply chain SaaS platforms power over 1M+ shipments per day. Strategic partner to India’s digital economy: We work with every major digital commerce player (ecomm, quick commerce, food, mobility) , and are expanding wallet share and capabilities within existing giants while co-creating new models with emerging platforms and brands.  Built to scale profitably: We’re not chasing GMV at all costs. We’re building the most capital-efficient, tech-enabled logistics engine in the country. We’re now building for our next phase: a 5X scale-up over the next 5 years, anchored in sharper client focus, deeper solutions, and new growth engines.  Founders/ Founding team:  Raghu Talluri (CEO) - Formerly at Myntra, McKinsey  Pramod Nair (CTO) - Formerly at Freecharge, Snapdeal, MartMobi  Rakib Ahmed (Co Founder, Head EComm/ Trucking/Warehousing)- Formerly at ICICI Prudential, Co founder Lunate Eco

title: Systems Operations Manager
description:
**About this role:**


Wells Fargo is seeking a...

 **In this role, you will:**

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

### **SRE \& Reliability Engineering**

* Lead and mature SRE practices across platforms and application ecosystems.
* Define and manage Service Level Indicators (SLIs), Service Level Objectives (SLOs), and Error Budgets.
* Drive reliability, availability, scalability, and performance improvements.
* Establish proactive monitoring, alerting, and automated remediation strategies.
* Reduce operational toil through engineering\-led solutions.

### **Platform \& Application Support**

* Own production support, platform operations, and service stability for business\-critical applications.
* Ensure adherence to operational KPIs including availability, MTTR, incident reduction, and change success rates.
* Lead major incident management, problem management, and root cause analysis activities.
* Drive continuous service improvement initiatives.

### **Automation \& Engineering Excellence**

* Develop and implement automation strategies across infrastructure, application, and operational workflows.
* Automate deployment, recovery, patching, monitoring, and operational processes.
* Leverage Infrastructure as Code (IaC), CI/CD, and self\-healing capabilities.
* Champion DevOps and GitOps engineering practices.

### **Observability \& Platform Monitoring**

* Establish enterprise observability capabilities across applications and platforms.
* Implement centralized logging, metrics, tracing, synthetic monitoring, and AIOps solutions.
* Drive adoption of tools such as Splunk, Dynatrace, Datadog, Prometheus, Grafana, New Relic, AppDynamics, or OpenTelemetry.
* Improve visibility into platform health, customer experience, and business service performance.

### **Platform Transformation \& Modernization**

* Lead transformation initiatives involving cloud migration, platform modernization, containerization, and operational excellence.
* Partner with Architecture, Engineering, Security, and Infrastructure teams to modernize platforms.
* Drive resilience engineering, chaos testing, capacity planning, and disaster recovery improvements.
* Implement best practices for cloud\-native operations and enterprise\-scale support models.

### **Leadership \& Stakeholder Management**

* Build, mentor, and lead geographically distributed SRE and Support teams.
* Establish a culture of accountability, innovation, continuous learning, and operational excellence.
* Partner with business leaders, engineering teams, and senior stakeholders to align operational priorities with business objectives.
* Provide executive\-level reporting on service health, reliability trends, risks, and transformation initiatives.

============================

* 5\+ years of Systems Engineering, and Technology Architecture experience, or equivalent demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, military experience, education

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or related field.

* Deep understanding of Site Reliability Engineering principles and practices.
* Strong hands\-on expertise in Linux/Unix, Windows, Cloud Platforms (AWS/Azure/GCP), and distributed systems.
* Experience with Kubernetes, Docker, OpenShift, or container orchestration platforms.
* Expertise in incident management, problem management, change management, and operational governance.
* Strong scripting/programming skills in Python, PowerShell, Shell, Java, or similar languages.
* Experience implementing CI/CD pipelines and Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Ansible, CloudFormation, etc.)
* Experience in large\-scale enterprise application support environments.
* Knowledge of AIOps, event correlation, automated remediation, and predictive operations.
* Experience with ServiceNow, Jira, GitHub, Azure DevOps, AutoSys, Control\-M, or similar tools.
* Certifications in AWS, Azure, Kubernetes, ITIL, SRE, or DevOps.
* Experience leading cloud transformation and platform modernization programs.

**Key Success Measures**
========================

* Improved Service Availability and Reliability.
* Reduction in Major Incidents and Recurring Problems.
* Improved MTTR and Incident Resolution Efficiency.
* Increased Automation Coverage and Reduced Operational Toil.
* Enhanced Observability and Early Detection Capabilities.
* Successful Delivery of Platform Modernization Initiatives.
* Improved Change Success Rate and Operational Stability.
* High Team Engagement, Capability Development, and Stakeholder Satisfaction.

### **Ideal Candidate Profile**


A hands\-on engineering leader who can **operate at strategic and execution levels**, drive **SRE maturity**, champion **automation and observability**, modernize platforms, and build a culture of **reliability, resilience, and operational excellence** across enterprise applications and infrastructure.
