title: Associate General Manager
description:
**Associate General Manager – Facility Management** 




**Location:** 
 Mumbai
 



  





**About Us** 




  





 StayVista is
 **India’s largest villa hospitality brand** 
 and has redefined group getaways. Our handpicked luxury villas are present in every famous holiday destination across the country. We curate unique experiences paired with top\-notch hospitality, creating unforgettable stays.
 **Here, you will be a part of our passionate team, dedicated to crafting exceptional getaways and curating one\-of\-a\-kind homes.** 
 We are a close\-knit tribe, united by a shared love for travel and on a mission to become the most loved hospitality brand in India.
 



  





**Why Work With Us?** 




  





 At StayVista, you're part of a community where your ideas and growth matter. We’re a fast\-growing team that values continuous improvement. With our skill upgrade programs, you’ll keep learning and evolving, just like we do. And hey, when you’re ready for a break, our villa discounts make it easy to enjoy the luxury you help create.
 



  





**Your Role** 




  





 As an
 **Associate General Manager at StayVista,** 
 you will be responsible for the development and operations of StayVista's Facility Management, creating frameworks for property maintenance, utilities, security, and other key services. Responsibilities include expanding the client base, managing contracts, implementing SOPs, and overseeing daily villa operations to ensure guest\-ready properties and high service standards. You’ll stay current on industry trends to drive continuous improvement and innovation.
 



  





**About You** 




  




* Overseeing Daily Operations\- Make sure everything in the resorts and villas works smoothly \- from the lights to the pools to the rooms. Ensure regular maintenance and repairs are done on time to avoid problems.
* Managing the Team\- Lead and support the staff who take care of maintenance, cleaning and security at all locations. Make sure everyone is properly trained and working well together.
* Budgeting and Cost Control\- Help create the budget for maintenance and repairs. Keep track of costs and make sure everything stays within budget.
* Safety and Compliance\- Ensure all facilities are safe for both staff and guests. Make sure the resorts meet local safety rules and regulations (like fire safety, health codes, etc.).
* Guest Satisfaction\- Ensure that the resort/villa's facilities are in top shape to make sure guests have a great experience. Handle any complaints related to maintenance or cleanliness.
* Renovation and Projects\- Help manage any big renovations or upgrades needed for the resorts and villas. Ensure new resorts or villas are set up properly.
* Using Technology\- Use tools and systems to track maintenance, staff schedules and costs. Implement energy\-saving measures to reduce costs and be more eco\-friendly.
* Reporting and Improvements\- Keep track of how well everything is running and report back to the Facility Head. Suggest ways to improve operations, based on what’s working and what isn’t.
* Sustainability\- Implement eco\-friendly practices, like saving water and energy and reducing waste.
* Travel\- Travel to different locations across India to ensure all the resorts and villas are in good condition. Fix major issues on\-site if needed.
* Do Regular Audits\- Visit each location to check if everything is clean, safe and working properly. Use a checklist to inspect things like rooms, kitchens, maintenance areas, gardens, etc.
* Support Quality Checks\- Help make sure all staff follow the company’s quality and cleanliness standards.
* Bachelor’s/Master’s degree in Business, Hospitality Management, Real Estate, or a related field.
* This position includes tasks supporting Owner and Guest Management, as determined by organizational needs.



  





**Bonus Points \- These are non\-essential, but a bonus if you have them!** 




  




* Experience managing multi\-location hospitality or luxury villa operations.
* Proficiency with facility management software and digital audit tools.



  





**Key Metrics: what you will drive and achieve** 




  




* Guest Experience % 3 star or below
* Owner Feedback Average should not be below 3 "FM Ops Tracker (AMC, R\&M, Inventory \& Supplies)"
* Completion of Ops tracker within the timeline. (Inventory, AMC, vendor payments, daily tracker) Track AMC and repair \& maintenance schedules (equipment upkeep, pool \& utility maintenance).
* Ensure adequate material/consumables
* .Mystery Audit Above 80% average of all properties (each property per month) Staffing of properties (inbound) Deployment within TAT (03 weeks)



  





**Our Core Values:** 
 Are you a
 ***CURATER?***




  




* **Curious** 
 : Here, your curiosity fuels innovation.
* **User\-Centric** 
 : You’ll anticipate the needs of all our stakeholders and exceed expectations.
* **Resourceful** 
 : You’ll creatively optimise our resources with solutions that elevate experiences in unexpected ways.
* **Aspire** 
 : Keep learning, keep growing—because we’re all about continuous improvement.
* **Trust** 
 : Trust is our foundation. You’ll work in a transparent, reliable, and fair environment.
* **Enjoy** 
 : We believe in having fun while building something extraordinary.



  





  





**StayVista Spirit: Our Behavioural Competencies – How We Work Together** 




  




* **Business Acumen:** 
 You know our services, business drivers, and industry trends inside out. You anticipate challenges in your area, weigh the impact of decisions, and track competitors to stay ahead, viewing risk as a chance to excel.
* **Change Management:** 
 You embrace change and actively look for opportunities to improve efficiency. You navigate ambiguity well, promote innovation within the team, and take ownership of implementing fresh ideas.
* **Leadership:** 
 You provide direction, delegate effectively, and empower your team to take ownership. You foster passion and pride in achieving goals, holding yourself accountable for the team’s successes and failures.
* **Customer Centricity:** 
 You know your customers’ business and proactively find solutions to resolve their challenges. By building rapport and anticipating issues, you ensure smooth, win\-win interactions while keeping stakeholders in the loop.
* **Teamwork:** 
 You actively seek input from others, work across departments, and leverage team diversity to drive success. By fostering an open environment, you encourage constructive criticism and share knowledge to achieve team goals.
* **Result Orientation:** 
 You set clear goals for yourself and your team, overcoming obstacles with a positive, solution\-focused mindset. You take ownership of outcomes and make informed decisions based on cost\-benefit analysis.
* **Planning and Organizing:** 
 You analyze information systematically, prioritize tasks, and delegate effectively. You optimize processes to drive efficiency and ensure compliance with organizational standards.
* **Communication:** 
 You communicate with confidence and professionalism, balancing talking and listening to foster open discussions. You identify key players and use the right channels to ensure clarity and gain support.

title: Senior Facility Executive- Soft Services
description:
**Senior Soft Services Executive \- Job Description**
 Position Overview
   

  

 The Senior Soft Services Executive is responsible for overseeing and managing the delivery of soft facilities management services across assigned properties or client portfolios. This role ensures high\-quality service delivery, client satisfaction, operational excellence, and continuous improvement in soft services operations.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

**Service Delivery Management** 
 Oversee day\-to\-day operations of soft services including cleaning, security, landscaping, waste management, pest control, catering, reception, and mailroom services. Ensure all services meet contractual obligations, service level agreements (SLAs), and quality standards. Conduct regular site inspections and quality audits to maintain service excellence.
   

  

**Client Relationship Management** 
 Serve as the primary point of contact for clients regarding soft services matters. Build and maintain strong client relationships through regular meetings, reporting, and proactive communication. Address client concerns promptly and implement corrective actions to ensure satisfaction.
   

  

**Vendor and Contractor Management** 
 Manage relationships with soft services vendors and subcontractors. Monitor vendor performance against KPIs and SLAs. Negotiate contracts, review pricing, and ensure cost\-effective service delivery. Conduct vendor evaluations and implement improvement plans as needed.
   

  

**Financial Management** 
 Develop and manage soft services budgets for assigned properties or portfolios. Monitor expenses, identify cost\-saving opportunities, and ensure services are delivered within budget parameters. Prepare financial reports and forecasts for management review.
   

  

**Team Leadership** 
 Lead, mentor, and develop soft services team members including supervisors and coordinators. Conduct performance reviews, provide training, and foster a culture of accountability and excellence. Coordinate staff scheduling and resource allocation.
   

  

**Compliance and Health \& Safety** 
 Ensure all soft services operations comply with health, safety, environmental regulations, and JLL standards. Maintain compliance documentation and certifications. Conduct risk assessments and implement safety protocols. Coordinate incident reporting and resolution.
   

  

**Continuous Improvement** 
 Identify opportunities for operational improvements and innovation in service delivery. Implement best practices and new technologies to enhance efficiency and quality. Lead process improvement initiatives and track results.
   

  

**Required Qualifications**
**Experience** 
 5\-8 years of experience in facilities management with significant focus on soft services. Proven track record managing multiple sites or large\-scale facilities. Experience in vendor management and contract administration.
   

  

**Education** 
 Bachelor's degree in Facilities Management, Business Administration, or related field preferred. Professional certifications (IFMA, RICS, or equivalent) are advantageous.
   

  

**Skills and Competencies** 
 Strong leadership and people management capabilities. Excellent client service orientation and communication skills. Financial acumen with budget management experience. Problem\-solving ability and attention to detail. Proficiency in FM software and Microsoft Office Suite. Understanding of health and safety regulations and compliance requirements.
   

  

**Personal Attributes** 
 Professional demeanor with ability to interact with senior stakeholders. Proactive and results\-oriented approach. Ability to work under pressure and manage multiple priorities. Strong organizational and time management skills.

 This role typically requires site\-based presence .

title: Manager - IT Office Operations
description:
Etraveli Group is a leading global flight technology provider, specializing in flight sales and offering flight content delivery and fintech products. We are here to solve complexity, by connecting millions of flights and travelers across the globe, from search and selection to trip and beyond.


We partner with major global platforms such as Booking.com, Google Flights, Skyscanner, and Kayak, providing seamless flight booking and related services. Our B2B portfolio includes Precision, our specialist in travel fintech; Tripstack, our B2B Flights as a Service Provider and world leader in virtual interlining, serving as the gateway to Etraveli Group’s flight content and fulfillment services; Wenrix, the AI Infrastructure for profitable growth in air; and Flygresor.se, Sweden’s leading flight comparison site. We also operate our own online travel agency brands including Gotogate, Mytrip, and Flightnetwork.


Every day we strive to make the world smaller for our customers and bigger for our people. Our diverse team of more than 3200 passionate professionals is what makes us the industry’s tech wonder and the best in the world at what we do.


Major offices in Sweden (HQ), Greece, India, Canada, Israel, Poland, UK, and Uruguay.


##### **The Role**


We're excited to be expanding our leadership team in India and are looking for an IT Manager to oversee our IT Office Operations across our Pune and Mumbai offices.


Reporting directly to the Senior Manager IT Office Operations (based in Gothenburg), you will lead and empower a dynamic team of 14 IT Engineers who are responsible for our global service desk, client security, user access management, and 24/7 on\-call support for Etraveli Group. The global ITOO team extends with an additional 12 IT Engineers in Sweden and Greece collaborating together on operations and continuous improvement.


As a people\-centric leader, you will balance line management with tactical execution, ensuring high service quality, operational efficiency, and a supportive team environment.


##### **Job Responsibility**


* **Line management for a team of 14 IT Engineers, handling yearly performance reviews cycle, driving personal development, and managing scheduling/rotas for global support and on\-call coverage.**
* Manage, prioritize, and monitor team workload and IT ticketing progress (Jira and JSM) to ensure timely resolution and high service standards across the global service desk.
* Serve as a key escalation path for complex IT issues, major incidents, and operational bottlenecks.
* Lead incident management, coordinating rapid response and mitigation when critical systems or operations are impacted.
* Oversee key functional domains within the team, including Client Security, User Access Management, and equipment lifecycle management.
* Manage local vendor relationships, service contracts, and IT asset procurement for the Pune and Mumbai offices.
* Continuously improve ways of working, operational routines, and technical documentation across global and local IT operations.
* Participate actively in global IT Office Operations meetings, different SME team meetings, and align local execution with global strategy.
* Ensure local office infrastructure (computers Win11, printers, meeting room AV/conferencing gear, mobile devices) is fully supported and operational.
* Coordination with the network and server infrastructure team for business continuity and uptime.
* Coordinate with the local operations team for the feedback, local/global deliveries and service improvements.

##### **Job Requirement**


* **8\-14 years of overall experience in IT Office Operations.**
* **Global experience preferred**
* **3\+ years of proven experience in line management/leadership roles within IT (mandatory).**
* Broad background in IT, ideally with significant experience in IT support or service desk management.
* Demonstrated experience tracking IT support metrics, managing ticketing workflows, and monitoring team progress.
* Strong business acumen to understand business impact and appropriately prioritize major incidents and problems.
* Solid conceptual understanding of IT server and network infrastructure principles (valuable).
* Fluent written and spoken English with excellent communication skills.

##### **Thorough On Boarding Process**


We are building a stellar onboarding adventure just for you, spanning your first 120 days, including access to learning resources, Q\&A sessions with our CEO and a buddy program.


##### **Competitive Benefits**


We pay fairly and align compensation with your role's impact on the company. Referral bonus, pension and insurances are also applicable, with some variations across our locations.


##### **Wellbeing \& Community**


In order to be the best version of you every day, you need an environment that provides for your wellbeing. From breakfast \& good coffee to start your day to healthcare, employee assistance plans and team bonding events we've got you covered!


##### **Opportunities for Development**


You will find extensive learning opportunities, team training and workshops connected to your role as well as guidance from renown leaders, all provided in a fast pace environment with flat hierarchies.


##### **Hybrid Work**


We want you to enjoy the best of all worlds and we know that doesn't always mean working at the office. We have a hybrid policy, including working from anywhere 2 weeks every year.


##### **Diversity disclaimer**


*At Etraveli Group we value diversity; we pride ourselves on being a company represented by people of all different backgrounds.* *During hiring, we are committed to ensure equality and promote diversity in the workplace at every selection stage. As such, we provide the same opportunities for all candidates regardless of race, religion or belief, gender, nationality, ethnicity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, or any other characteristic protected under any anti\-discrimination law or regulation.*

title: Operations Manager
description:
Job Description

**Title:** Operations Manager – Clinics (Mumbai)  
**Reports to:** Cluster Manager  
**Direct reports:** Sr Ops – 1 per clinic × all clinics in Mumbai  
**Location:** Mumbai — field role, daily travel across clinic locations (own vehicle/two\-wheeler preferred; travel reimbursed)

About Pravaayu

Pravaayu is a Mumbai\-based specialty healthcare chain delivering non\-surgical, evidence\-based treatment for bone and joint pain, built on our proprietary CVRT® protocol (published in EJPMR). We're not a wellness or lifestyle\-Ayurveda brand — we run clinics with clinical rigor, measured outcomes (WOMAC, ROM, MMT), and an NPS of 91\.

Role Summary

This person owns day\-to\-day operational health across all Pravaayu clinics in Mumbai, managing the Sr Ops at each clinic and rolling up city\-level operational performance to the Cluster Manager. They are the layer between on\-ground execution (Sr Ops, clinic staff) and cluster\-level oversight — the person who ensures every clinic runs to protocol, every day, without needing the Cluster Manager to intervene on routine issues.

Key Responsibilities

**1\. Sr Ops Management \& Field Oversight**

* Direct management of Sr Ops (one per clinic) — daily check\-ins, weekly performance review, coaching against KRA/KPI framework
* Physical clinic visits on a fixed rotation across all 6 locations; unannounced spot\-checks in addition to scheduled visits
* Escalation point for any issue Sr Ops can't resolve at clinic level (staffing gaps, vendor failures, patient complaints, compliance flags)
* Own hiring/backfill TAT for Sr Ops role itself, in coordination with HR (Ritika)

**2\. Patient Experience Operations**

* Audit patient journey execution at each clinic (intake → consultation → therapy delivery → discharge) against CVRT® protocol and SOPs
* Own clinic\-level NPS and complaint resolution TAT; ensure Sr Ops are executing the patient experience standard consistently across all sites, not just the flagship clinic

**3\. Manpower Operations (via Sr Ops)**

* Ensure Sr Ops are maintaining attendance, roster adequacy, and shift coverage at each clinic
* Cross\-clinic staffing view — identify patterns (e.g., recurring gaps at one location) that a single Sr Ops might miss
* Backup staffing plan across clinics for leave clashes/attrition

**4\. Inventory, Equipment \& Facility Management**

* Consolidated stock and equipment\-uptime view across all clinics; hold Sr Ops accountable for zero stockouts and preventive maintenance adherence
* Vendor management for facility, equipment, and consumables at the city level — negotiate rates/SLAs centrally, Sr Ops execute locally
* Facility standard enforcement — clinics must read as premium/aspirational across all locations, not just where leadership visits most

**5\. Process, Compliance \& SOP Adherence**

* City\-wide compliance tracker (licenses, biomedical waste, fire safety, POSH, labour) — Sr Ops report status, Operations Manager owns zero\-lapse accountability
* Ensure Master Clinical Protocol (ICM: Assessment → Stratification → Intervention → Measurement → Iteration) documentation and outcome\-tracking discipline is uniform across all clinics
* Own and refine SOPs; when one clinic solves a problem well, institutionalize it across all via Sr Ops

**6\. Reporting to Cluster Manager**

* Own the daily/weekly city\-level ops dashboard (footfall, staffing, complaints, stockouts, compliance) across all clinics
* Weekly written report to Cluster Manager: RAG status per clinic, issues resolved at Operations Manager level, issues escalated upward, action plan

Success Metrics (First 6 Months)MetricTargetClinic NPS (across all)≥85, no single clinic below 80Stockout incidentsZeroStatutory compliance lapsesZeroSr Ops attrition\<10% in first 6 months (indicates coaching, not just enforcement)Weekly report to Cluster Manager100% on\-timeEquipment downtime resolution\<24 hrsRequirements

* 5–8 years in multi\-site operations management with **direct people management of location\-level managers/supervisors** — healthcare, diagnostics, wellness chains, retail, or QSR (healthcare/diagnostics preferred)
* Demonstrated experience managing a team of managers (not just individual contributors) across geographically spread sites
* Comfortable with heavy daily travel across Mumbai (own vehicle strongly preferred)
* Data\-literate — daily dashboard tracking across 6 sites simultaneously
* High ownership, low ego
* Bachelor's degree minimum; healthcare administration/operations background a plus

Nice\-to\-Have

* Prior experience in a specialty clinic chain, diagnostics chain (Metropolis/Thyrocare\-type), or physiotherapy/rehab network
* Exposure to NABH or clinical compliance frameworks
* Bilingual Hindi/Marathi/English

description:
Job Description – Operation Manager

**No of Position** : 3  
**Location:** BKC, Andheri to Sakinaka \& Powai  
**Department:** Operations  
**Reporting To:** Zonal Head / AGM – Operations

**Job Purpose:**  
To ensure smooth and effective operations across all assigned client sites, maintain required manpower, ensure client satisfaction, monitor site performance, resolve operational issues, and ensure compliance with company processes and client requirements.

Key Responsibilities

* **Manpower Management**
* Ensure 100% manpower deployment at all assigned sites without shortage.
* Monitor vacancies, absenteeism, replacements and deployment of guards.
* Coordinate with the recruitment team for timely manpower requirements.

* **Leadership \& Team Management**

* Ensure proper communication and coordination between the field team and office.

* **Issue Resolution**
* Resolve operational issues received through email, phone or physical communication.
* Take immediate corrective action on client complaints, manpower issues, guard grievances and site discrepancies.

* **Overall Operational Accountability**
* Ensure smooth functioning of all assigned sites within the area.
* Ensure company policies, SOPs and client\-specific instructions are followed at all sites.
* Maintain proper coordination between clients, guards, Area Officers, Zone recruitment, billing and management.
* Take ownership of operational performance and ensure continuous improvement in service quality.

title: Team Leader, Fund Operations
description:
**Overview**Responsible for managing and developing a team of Fund accountants and Senior Fund accounts. To act as the subject matter expert in Fund operations – Cash recon, position, recon, NAV calcs and reviews. Work with various internal business units to improve processes and procedures; work with the client service team to deliver high quality services to existing clients and support new client or products.  

  

**Key Accountabilities and main responsibilities**Strategic Focus
* Lead, develop and manage a team of Fund accountants and Senior fund accountants’.
* Provide leadership and guidance to staff, fostering an environment that encourages employee engagement, teamwork and communication
* Lead and facilitate performance management and career development processes with staff. Make decisions for staffing and provide training to staff.
* Develop periodic goals, organize the work, set short\-term priorities, monitor all activities, and ensure timely and accurate delivery of the work by the team.
* Monitor work distribution and ensure resources are used effectively both within the team. Adapt the team structure as required to meet the evolving needs of the business and clients.
* Initiate, develop and implement short\- and long\-term plans to improve the effectiveness of team processes and functions.
Operational Management
* Act as the subject matter expert and direct the activities of the team to prepare standard, complex and ad hoc NAV calculations including trade, position and cash recons and tax reporting which supports highly sophisticated institutional clients, investment professionals and marketing materials.
* Proactively ensure a strong understanding of end\-to\-end processes, controls, data flows, roles and responsibilities involved in performing Fund accounting responsibilities.
People Leadership
* Evaluate opportunities to improve processes and procedures to ensure optimal productivity and quality of output to deliver client satisfaction.
* Influence and partner with the operations and technology teams and service providers / vendors to ensure data quality, identity and resolve issues related to performance and reporting as needed.
* Ensure all client queries / issues raised are responded to in a timely and appropriate manner.
Governance \& Risk
* Ensure effective policies, procedures and controls are in place, well documented and maintained.
* Calculate and/or review NAVs and all end to end related processes.
* Ensure SLA are met with minimal to no exceptions or escalations.
* Get involved in migration to a new accounting system and help in cross training the team with the new system and processes..
* Ensure management fees and performance fees are calculated as per the fund document.

**Role Category:** Production \& Manufacturing  
**Location:** Mumbai / Factory Location as Applicable

Job Description

We are looking for an experienced **Production Manager** to manage end\-to\-end production of PPE, workwear, technical textile, or protective clothing manufacturing, manufactured as per applicable **International standards**. The candidate should have strong knowledge of garment production, technical textile handling, sewing operations, quality control, production planning, and compliance requirements for protective clothing used in industrial safety applications, preferably.

Key Responsibilities

· Lead complete production operations for protective garment components.

· Ensure manufacturing is carried out as per approved technical specifications, buyer requirements, production files, and applicable International standards for protective ensembles.

· Plan daily, weekly, and monthly production schedules based on order quantity, delivery timelines, machine capacity, manpower, and material availability.

· Coordinate with cutting, stitching, sealing, finishing, inspection, packing, stores, purchase, quality, and dispatch teams for smooth production flow.

· Monitor line efficiency, output, productivity, WIP, rejection levels, rework, and on\-time delivery performance.

· Ensure correct handling and usage of technical fabrics.

· Oversee critical operations such as layer matching, seam construction, reinforcement, attachment, closures, labelling, finishing, and final inspection.

· Maintain strict quality control at all production stages to meet safety, performance, and certification\-related requirements.

· Work closely with the Quality Assurance team for in\-line inspection, final inspection, testing coordination, documentation, and corrective action implementation.

· Identify production bottlenecks and implement recovery plans to meet delivery commitments.

· Train supervisors, line leaders, operators, and quality checkers on SOPs, workmanship standards, safety requirements, and product\-specific quality points.

· Maintain production reports, efficiency reports, rejection analysis, manpower planning, material consumption records, and order status updates.

· Ensure compliance with factory safety, housekeeping, 5S, and process discipline requirements.

· Support new product development, sampling, pilot runs, production trials, and bulk production approvals.

Team Management Responsibilities

· Lead, supervise, and motivate production supervisors, line leaders, operators, helpers, quality checkers, finishing staff, and packing teams.

· Allocate manpower across cutting, stitching, sealing, finishing, inspection, and packing sections based on production priority and skill level.

· Set daily production targets for each line and review achievement against plan with supervisors and line leaders.

· Conduct daily production meetings to review output, bottlenecks, quality issues, absenteeism, manpower gaps, and delivery priorities.

· Develop accountability among supervisors and line leaders for productivity, quality, discipline, safety, and housekeeping on the shop floor.

· Train and upgrade operators on critical operations, technical garment handling, workmanship standards, SOPs, and product\-specific quality requirements.

· Evaluate team performance and recommend skill development, cross\-training, redeployment, or corrective action where required.

· Maintain strong shop\-floor discipline, attendance control, shift planning, overtime planning, and smooth coordination between departments.

· Create a safe, organized, and performance\-driven production environment focused on teamwork, quality, and timely delivery.

Safety Compliance Responsibilities – International Certification

· Ensure production processes support compliance with International Certification requirements for protective ensembles and related protective garment elements.

· Coordinate with Quality Assurance, testing laboratories, certification bodies, and customer compliance teams for **certification**, product evaluation, surveillance audits, and certification\-related documentation.

· Maintain production traceability for certified components including outer shell fabrics, moisture barriers, thermal liners, reflective trims, threads, closures, labels, and other approved accessories.

· Monitor workmanship and critical safety construction points such as seam type, stitch density, seam strength, reinforcement, reflective tape placement, garment layering, closure attachment, and labeling accuracy.

· Implement shop\-floor controls to prevent material mix\-ups, unauthorized substitutions, deviation from approved specifications, and non\-compliant production practices.

· Maintain readiness for audits, customer audits, product inspections, document reviews, corrective action verification, and factory surveillance visits.

· Ensure production and quality records are maintained for batch traceability, inspection results, test reports, non\-conformance closure, corrective actions, and certificate support.

· Train production teams on safety\-critical garment construction, approved processes, certification requirements, compliance points, and consequences of deviation from certified specifications.

Candidate Profile

· Minimum 5 years of experience in garment manufacturing, PPE manufacturing, workwear, uniforms, technical textiles, or protective clothing production.

· Strong understanding of apparel production processes including cutting, sewing, finishing, inspection, packing, and dispatch.

· Experience in handling multi\-layer garments, technical fabrics, special sewing operations, heavy\-duty machines, seam strength requirements, and critical safety\-related workmanship.

· Ability to read and understand tech packs, product specifications, measurement sheets, BOMs, production files, and quality manuals.

Education

Diploma / Degree in Textile Technology, Garment Manufacturing, Apparel Production, Industrial Engineering, , or any relevant technical field. Candidates with strong practical experience in protective garment production may also be considered.

Required Certifications / Standards Knowledge

· Familiarity with quality management systems such as **ISO 9001**, internal audits, SOP documentation, traceability, and corrective/preventive action processes.

· Training or certification in **Lean Manufacturing, 5S, Kaizen, Industrial Engineering, Production Planning, Quality Management, Safety Management, or PPE Compliance** will be an added advantage.

About the Role

This is a critical production leadership role for a manufacturing setup focused on certified fire safety and protective apparel. The selected candidate will be responsible for ensuring that production output meets delivery timelines, workmanship standards, safety expectations, and quality requirements for fire fighter suits and related protective garments.

 Major offices in Sweden (HQ), Greece, India, Canada, Israel, Poland, UK, and Uruguay.
   

  

 The Role

title: Manager, Packaging Supplier Performance
description:

 The
 **Manager, Packaging Supplier Performance, Sourcing \& Quality Assurance** 
 is responsible for ensuring Infinity Global's packaging suppliers consistently meet the company's standards for quality, delivery, cost, sustainability, and technical capability.
   

  

 This hands\-on role combines supplier assessment, sourcing, supplier development, packaging quality assurance, and production support. The role requires close collaboration with internal teams and international suppliers to drive continuous improvement and ensure the successful delivery of high\-quality packaging solutions to customers.
   

  

 The successful candidate will bring strong experience within the
 **packaging industry** 
 , with expertise in packaging manufacturing processes, materials, printing technologies, supplier management, and quality control.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Supplier Assessment \& Qualification**
* Conduct supplier audits and factory visits to assess capability, capacity, quality systems, and technical packaging expertise.
* Evaluate and qualify suppliers for new projects and business requirements.
* Develop and monitor supplier improvement plans where needed.


**Supplier Performance \& Relationship Management**
* Build and maintain strong supplier partnerships.
* Manage supplier KPIs covering quality, delivery, cost, sustainability, and service performance.
* Drive supplier performance reviews and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Oversee production follow\-up to ensure on\-time and compliant deliveries.


**Packaging Sourcing \& Supplier Development**
* Lead RFQ processes, supplier selection, benchmarking, and commercial negotiations.
* Source and develop suppliers specialising in paper\-based, printed, and luxury packaging solutions.
* Manage sample development, prototype approvals, and production readiness.
* Identify and qualify new suppliers to support growth, innovation, and capacity needs.


**Quality Assurance \& Claims Management**
* Establish and maintain packaging quality standards across materials, printing, finishing, construction, and functionality.
* Lead quality investigations and corrective action processes (RCA/CAPA) for supplier and customer claims.
* Conduct regular product inspections, factory audits, and quality reviews.
* Manage quality\-related cost recovery and supplier accountability where applicable.


**Data Analysis \& Reporting**
* Analyse supplier performance, spend, quality, and delivery data.
* Identify cost\-saving opportunities, supplier risks, and performance trends.
* Provide reporting and recommendations to support sourcing and supplier management strategies.


**Sustainability \& Compliance**
* Ensure supplier compliance with Infinity Global quality, sustainability, and ethical sourcing standards.
* Support supplier development initiatives related to certifications and responsible sourcing practices.


**Location \& Travel**

**Qualifications**
* 7\+ years of experience in packaging sourcing, supplier management, quality assurance, and project management.
* Minimum 5 years of experience within the packaging industry, preferably involving luxury packaging, paper packaging, rigid boxes, folding cartons, labels, or related packaging categories.
* Strong understanding of packaging materials, manufacturing processes, printing technologies, and finishing applications.
* Experience conducting supplier audits, factory assessments, and supplier development programmes.
* Demonstrated experience managing supplier quality issues and implementing corrective actions.
* Strong analytical skills with experience managing supplier performance data and KPIs.
* Knowledge of FSC, ISO 9001, ISO 14001, SA8000, and EcoVadis preferred.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and reporting tools.
* Fluent English, both written and spoken.


 The Partner Trusted by the World’s Leading Luxury Brands

 With each program, we collaborate with our clients to anticipate their needs\- developing custom strategies that allow us to act with agility\-quickly responding to challenges and rapidly shifting positions to meet the opportunities in this ever\-changing environment.

title: Lead Manager - Education and Technology
description:
The
 **Lead Manager – Education and Technology** 
 will lead Dharmalife Foundation's technology\-enabled education and skilling ecosystem across LUYM, BSBC and JAYA. The role sits at the intersection of technology, education, pedagogy, people, data and field implementation, with the overall mandate of ensuring that technology translates into better learning outcomes, stronger teaching and training capability, greater programme reach and measurable impact.
 



 The role will provide national leadership for digital learning platforms, learning quality, teaching and training standards, data and impact, responsible AI, safeguarding and digital governance.
 



  





**Responsibilities** 




  





**A. Digital Learning \& Product Leadership** 




 Own the technology\-enabled learning ecosystem and ensure that platforms are relevant, usable, adopted, and scalable across programmes and states.
 



**Platform \& Product Ownership** 



* Own the LUYM, Quest, Preschool, Roshni AI and JAYA platforms from product strategy and roadmap through implementation, adoption and continuous improvement.
* Translate programme, learner, teacher and field requirements into clear product priorities and technology solutions.
* Develop and maintain product roadmaps in alignment with organisational and programme priorities.
* Establish product priorities based on learner value, learning outcomes, usability, scalability, cost and evidence of impact.
* Drive continuous improvement based on user feedback, field experience, platform data and programme outcomes.
* Ensure platforms are simple and intuitive for students, teachers, trainers, DLEs and programme teams.



  





**Technology Adoption \& Field Implementation** 



* Drive adoption and effective utilisation of digital platforms across programme states.
* Work closely with State Managers to address technology\-related requirements, including
 **devices, connectivity, user capability, content and platform adoption** 
 .
* Establish implementation and onboarding processes for new technology solutions.
* Monitor platform adoption, utilisation and user experience across states.
* Identify field\-level technology bottlenecks and ensure timely resolution with relevant technology/product teams.
* Ensure technology solutions are appropriate for
 **rural, low\-connectivity and resource\-constrained environments** 
 .



**Government \& Institutional Coordination** 



* Support and lead technology\-related engagement with government departments, schools, Anganwadi’s, BSBC centres and other institutional stakeholders.
* Lead government approvals, renewals and periodic reviews required for technology\-enabled programme delivery.
* Build institutional partnerships that enable scale and sustainability of digital learning interventions.



**Innovation \& Partnerships** 



* Identify emerging technologies and evidence\-based innovations relevant to education and skilling.
* Evaluate potential EdTech, AI and technology partners.
* Lead pilots and proofs\-of\-concept before wider deployment.
* Build partnerships with technology companies, universities, research institutions and other ecosystem players.



  





**Thought Leadership, External Representation \& Knowledge Sharing** 



* Represent Dharma Life in relevant education, technology, skilling and social\-sector forums. Provide thought leadership on technology\-enabled learning, responsible AI and programme innovation. Share programme evidence and learnings, strengthen sector visibility, and build relationships with government, funders, technology partners, academic institutions and networks.



  





**B. Learning Quality, Pedagogy \& Workforce Capability** 




 Own national standards for teaching, training and learning quality, ensuring that technology strengthens—not replaces—effective human facilitation.
 



**Teaching \& Training Standards** 



* Establish national teaching and training standards across LUYM, BSBC and JAYA, covering lesson preparation, facilitation, learner engagement, assessment and digital tools. Promote inclusive, learner\-centric blended learning, supported by classroom observation, quality assessment, coaching and continuous improvement mechanisms.



  





**Teaching \& Training Workforce** 



* Provide
 **functional leadership** 
 to teachers and trainers across states for pedagogy, standards, quality and safeguarding.
* Lead national frameworks for recruitment, onboarding and capability development of teaching and training staff, in coordination with State Managers.
* Define competency frameworks and performance standards for teaching and training roles.
* Design and drive continuous professional development programmes.
* Use data, classroom observations and field feedback to identify capability gaps and design interventions.
* Build a culture of continuous learning and professional excellence among the teaching and training workforce.








**Curriculum \& Content Leadership** 



* Set priorities for curriculum and content development across LUYM, Preschool and JAYA.
* Ensure curriculum is aligned with programme objectives and learner needs.
* Oversee development of high\-quality digital and blended learning content.
* Ensure content is accessible, engaging, age\-appropriate and contextually relevant.
* Establish content quality assurance processes.
* Ensure AI\-assisted or AI\-generated educational content is appropriately reviewed by humans.



  





**C. Data, Impact \& Learning Intelligence** 




 Build a culture where Dharmalife measures learning and skilling outcomes—not simply programme activity.
 



**National Learning \& Programme Data** 



* Own the consolidation of state\-wise outcome and impact data across Preschool, LUYM and JAYA.
* Own the accuracy, completeness and consistency of data feeding into the DL One national dashboard.
* Establish clear definitions and data standards for:
* Enrolment \- Sessions delivered – Attendance \- Participation
* Curriculum completion \- Learning outcomes \- Skilling completion
* Conversion \- Retention



**Learning Analytics \& Impact** 



* Drive improvements in field\-level data capture so that reported utilisation reflects verified teaching and learning output rather than only hours or sessions logged.
* Develop dashboards and analytical tools that allow leadership to understand:
* Who is participating? How regularly are they participating?
* What are they learning? Where are learners dropping out?
* Which interventions are producing results?
* Establish mechanisms for baseline, periodic and endline learning assessment wherever appropriate.
* Use data to identify learning gaps, programme bottlenecks and opportunities for improvement.
* Translate field\-level data into actionable insights for State Managers, Programme Leads and senior leadership.



**Leadership \& Board Reporting** 



* Consolidate national programme and impact information for senior leadership and Board reporting.
* Ensure that reporting moves beyond activity metrics towards outcomes, impact and evidence of effectiveness.
* Present clear insights, trends, risks and recommendations to leadership.



  





**D. Responsible Technology, AI, Safeguarding \& Data Governance** 




 Ensure that Dharmalife's use of technology and AI is safe, ethical, inclusive, responsible and compliant.
 



**AI in Education** 



* Own the responsible adoption of AI across LUYM, Quest, Preschool, Roshni AI and JAYA. Develop an organisational framework for responsible AI in education and skilling.
* Identify appropriate AI use cases such as:
* Personalised learning ; AI\-assisted tutoring ; Content creation
* Teacher support ; Assessment and feedback; Translation and localisation
* Learning analytics
* Establish human oversight for AI\-enabled learner interactions.
* Define guardrails for AI\-generated educational content and learner\-facing applications.
* Monitor risks relating to bias, inaccurate information, inappropriate content, exclusion and learner profiling.



**Safeguarding** 



* Own safeguarding standards for the teaching and training workforce and technology\-enabled learning environments. Design, mandate and monitor safeguarding training, including
 **POCSO and POSH** 
 , as applicable.
* Ensure safe and appropriate interactions between learners and teachers/trainers across online and offline environments. Establish clear reporting, escalation and response mechanisms for safeguarding concerns.



**Data Protection \& Privacy** 



* Establish practices for secure collection, storage, access, use, sharing and retention of learner data, including appropriate consent for minors.
* Implement role\-based access and data\-sharing protocols, and ensure partners comply with Dharmalife’s applicable data\-protection, privacy and safeguarding requirements.



  





**Cross\-Functional Work Coordination** 




 The role will operate across functions and will be expected to connect
 **technology, pedagogy, programme implementation, data and field realities** 
 .
 



 The Lead Manager will:
 


* Work closely with State Managers to align technology, staffing, training, devices, connectivity and content requirements.
* Work with the Deputy Manager – Content, Communication \& Skilling to align curriculum, content, communication and skilling priorities.
* Coordinate with teaching and training teams to ensure consistent standards nationally. Work with technology/product partners on platform development and issue resolution.
* Collaborate with programme and impact teams to connect programme implementation with learning outcomes.
* Provide regular updates to the Chief of Staff and senior leadership.



  





**Qualifications and Experience** 



* Postgraduate degree in Education, Educational Technology, Technology, Management, Social Sector Management, Public Policy or a related field.
* 8–12 years of progressive experience in education, EdTech, digital learning, technology\-enabled programme delivery or social\-sector transformation.
* Demonstrated experience leading technology\-enabled education or skilling programmes at scale.
* Experience managing geographically distributed or multi\-state teams.
* Experience translating educational/programme requirements into technology or product solutions.
* Strong understanding of pedagogy, learning outcomes, and digital learning models.
* Experience with programme data, dashboards, analytics and impact measurement.
* Experience working with government departments, schools or institutional stakeholders.
* Working knowledge of child safeguarding, including POCSO and POSH.

**Supports in responding to RFP / RFIs**

**Operational Excellence**

**People related**

* Utilize technology \& tools to continually learn and innovate, share knowledge with team members and enhance service delivery.
* Understand EY and its service lines. Actively encourage team members to contribute ideas.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Globally mobile and flexible to travel to onsite locations
* Highly analytical, organized and meticulous consulting skills
* Strong academic history (degree in Business, Accounting, or similar work experience in similar industry, Big 4 preferred)
* Proficient in MS\-Office Suite, data analysis \& validation
* Team player with strong interpersonal skills
* Ability to prioritize deliverables effectively in order to achieve optimum results.


**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* Strong understanding of SOX and COSO framework
* CIA certification is preferred
* Strong academic history (degree in Business, Accounting, Engineering or similar)
* Strong multi\-project management skills
* Skilled at collaborating, motivating and guiding high performance teams.
* Cognitive problem solving capabilities, quick decision making skills and ability to handle complex situations with a calm demeanor
* Exceptional command on spoken and written English
* Globally mobile and flexible to travel to onsite locations

 A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast\-moving environment
   

  

 Opportunities to work with EY Risk \-Internal Audit practices global with leading businesses across a range of industries
   

  

**What Working At EY Offers**
 At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from start–ups to Fortune 500 companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.

We value our employees and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:

 Carbomax is a leading company at the forefront of sustainability and environmental solutions, specializing in the activated carbon market. We provide high quality activated carbon products and services to global corporate clients, delivering solutions across a wide range of industries, including water treatment and purification, air filtration and purification, and food \& beverage processes.
 



  





 Our solutions play a vital role in ensuring safe drinking water, managing wastewater, maintaining industrial and commercial air quality, and enhancing the quality of food and beverages through processes such as sugar refining, oil purification, beverage clarification, and alcohol production. By effectively removing contaminants, odors, and impurities, we help clients achieve operational excellence while supporting environmental sustainability.
 



  





 At Carbomax, our mission is to drive innovation, enhance operational efficiency, and contribute to global sustainability efforts. With cutting edge solutions, technical expertise, and an international perspective, we are committed to setting new industry standards and creating long term value for our clients worldwide.
 



  





 We are looking for a
 **Warehouse Office Manager \- Sri Lanka / India** 
 to support our commercial operations, ensure efficient supply chain processes, manage warehouse activities, and optimize inventory flow. The ideal candidate will be responsible for coordinating logistics operations, improving supply chain performance, ensuring smooth warehouse management, and supporting customer fulfillment requirements. Experience in supply chain management, warehouse operations, and international logistics will be highly valued.
 



  





**Qualifications** 




  




* Proficiency in English (written and spoken); Sinhala, Tamil, or Hindi is a plus
* Bachelor's degree preferred
* 5\-7 years of experience in warehouse administration, logistics, or supply chain operations
* Knowledge of warehouse management systems (WMS) and inventory software
* Strong organizational and multitasking skills
* Familiarity with local customs, import/export, and regulatory procedures in Sri Lanka and India
* Strong interpersonal and communication skills
* Ability to work on\-site at the warehouse facility



  





**What We Offer** 



* Opportunity to contribute to global sales strategy and growth
* Competitive compensation with performance based incentives
* Exposure to international markets and high profile clients
* Dynamic and growth focused work environment
* Career development opportunities in a leading environmental solutions company



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  




* Oversee daily warehouse office operations and administrative processes for Sri Lanka and India operations
* Coordinate inbound and outbound shipments, ensuring accurate documentation and timely processing
* Manage inventory records and reconcile stock discrepancies with the warehouse team
* Supervise warehouse administrative staff and coordinate schedules
* Liaise with logistics providers, customs agents, and suppliers to ensure smooth operations
* Ensure compliance with local regulatory, safety, and customs requirements in Sri Lanka and India
* Prepare and maintain reports on warehouse performance, stock levels, and shipment status
* Support cost control and process improvement initiatives within the warehouse

title: Store Manager
description:
At Crocs, Inc., every career offers a chance to make a real impact. No two journeys look the same. And that's exactly how we like it. Whether you’re welcoming customers into our stores, collaborating with global teams at our headquarters, or keeping operations moving at our distribution centers, your impact is real and valued. At Crocs, Inc. you’re not expected to fit a mold. You’re encouraged to break it and create something better.
   

  

**Overview**
 As the
 **Store Manager** 
 , you will lead a dedicated team of store associates \& leaders every day, to create an exceptional consumer experience. Your focus will be on driving sales, providing excellent customer service, maintaining visual presentations, and developing talent within the store. This role offers opportunity to grow and collaborate with industry leading teammates and partners.
   

  

****What You'll Do****
* Deliver outstanding service to our consumers using our C.H.A.R.M service model
* Leads the store team in surpassing performance metrics including sales, consumer service and charms
* Apply analytical thinking \& company reporting to find opportunities within store, empowering the team to make strategic decisions
* Lead visual presentation, product flow, replenishment, and operational standards throughout the store
* Build Foster a welcoming, inclusive environment that engages promotes internal growth and builds an external network of talent
* Coordinate, delegate, prioritize and meet store deadlines while ensuring effective follow up on daily activities
* Contribute to crafting a team environment that encourages sharing of suggestions, ideas, and concerns while upholding Crocs Inc. values
* Learn \& assist in various departments including consumer service, product knowledge, visual presentation, and stock room management.
* Support team members in the daily execution of retail operations i.e., POS system management and use, stock replenishment, assist in pricing and markdown processes seasonally, promote loyalty programs, maintain cleanliness and recovery standards etc.
* Adhere to Crocs, Inc. Asset Protection policies and procedures, including shortage prevention, inventory control, and compliance procedures


****What You'll Bring to the Table****
  

  

* Must be 18 years or older
+ 4\+ years of total retail experience, preferably with previous Store Manager experience.

* Proven leadership skills with the ability to challenge, empower, and drive team results
* Strong communication skills (written and verbal) to successfully connect with store team members, operations managers, district managers and corporate partners
* Desire to succeed in a high growth, fast\-paced retail environment
* Flexibility in work schedule including availability for nights, weekends, holidays and extended hour s

title: Shift Leader Process Engineer
description:
Welcome to Haleon. We’re a purpose\-driven, world\-class consumer company putting everyday health in the hands of millions. In just three years since our launch, we’ve grown, evolved and are now entering an exciting new chapter – one filled with bold ambitions and enormous opportunity.
   

  

 Our trusted portfolio of brands – including Sensodyne®, Panadol®, Advil®, Voltaren®, Theraflu®, Otrivin®, and Centrum® – lead in resilient and growing categories. What sets us apart is our unique blend of deep human understanding and trusted science.
   

  

 Now it’s time to fully realise the full potential of our business and our people. We do this through our Win as One strategy. It puts our purpose – to deliver better everyday health with humanity – at the heart of everything we do. It unites us, inspires us, and challenges us to be better every day, driven by our agile, performance\-focused culture.
   

  

**Location: Indore**
**About The Role**
 The Shift Leader \- Process Area is accountable for safe, compliant and efficient manufacturing execution during the assigned shift and provides frontline leadership to Process Technician Associates and other Process team members.
   

  

 The role leads daily production delivery, GMP and EHS compliance, process control, shift coordination, people deployment, capability building and performance improvement within the Process area.
   

  

 The incumbent partners with Packaging, Quality, Maintenance, Engineering, Warehouse and HAPS teams to deliver right\-first\-time production, reliable supply and effective resolution of operational issues.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Lead Process operations during the assigned shift and deliver the approved production plan against Safety, Quality, Service, Cost and People objectives.
* Allocate people and resources, confirm shift readiness and ensure raw materials, equipment, documentation and utilities are available for production.
* Ensure start\-up, shutdown, product changeover, cleaning, sanitization and process execution are completed in accordance with SOPs, batch instructions and validated parameters.
* Monitor critical process parameters, cycle performance, yield, waste, equipment condition and schedule adherence, and take timely action on abnormalities.
* Ensure accurate completion and review of batch manufacturing records, cleaning records, equipment logs, electronic entries and shift documentation.
* Lead immediate containment and escalation of safety events, process deviations, quality risks, equipment failures and material issues.
* Support investigations, root\-cause analysis, CAPA, change controls, risk assessments and verification of sustainable corrective actions.
* Lead structured shift handovers and Daily Direction Setting, maintaining clear priorities, escalation, action ownership and performance visibility.
* Coach, train and qualify Process Technician Associates, provide performance feedback and support multi\-skilling and succession development.
* Partner with Maintenance and Engineering on breakdown response, preventive maintenance, basic equipment care and restoration of equipment base condition.
* Support commissioning, qualification, validation, engineering trials, technology transfer and operational\-readiness activities.
* Drive HAPS, 5S, visual management, loss elimination, waste reduction and continuous improvement within the Process area.
* Maintain the Process area in a safe, compliant, orderly and inspection\-ready condition and support internal and external audits


**Qualification And Experience**
* Bachelor’s degree in electrical/mechanical engineering or a closely related engineering discipline from a reputed institution preferably IIT/NIT etc.
* Relevant training in GMP, process operations, safety, Lean or frontline leadership is desirable.
* 6\-10 years of manufacturing or process\-operations experience, including 2\-3 years leading shop\-floor teams or shifts.
* Experience in FMCG, consumer healthcare, pharmaceuticals, food or another regulated manufacturing environment is preferred.
* Exposure to greenfield commissioning, qualification, validation or manufacturing start\-up is desirable.


**Technical Skills**
* Process manufacturing operations, equipment and material flow.
* GMP, batch documentation, data integrity, cleaning and in\-process control.
* Production planning, shift execution, process parameters, yield and schedule adherence.
* First\-line troubleshooting, root\-cause analysis and CAPA support.
* DDS/DMS, HAPS, 5S, visual management and continuous improvement.
* Working knowledge of SAP, MES, SCADA, Power BI or related manufacturing systems is desirable.


**Leadership Skills**
* Frontline leadership, coaching and capability development.
* Clear decision\-making and escalation under operational pressure.
* Strong communication and effective shift handover.
* Collaboration across Operations, Quality, Maintenance and Engineering.
* Ownership, accountability and a strong safety and compliance mindset.
* Fair people deployment, constructive feedback and respectful conflict resolution.


**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**
* Safety \& Compliance \- Safe shift execution, GMP adherence, training compliance and timely closure of assigned actions.
* Quality \- Right\-first\-time performance (RFT), documentation accuracy, process adherence and deviation reduction and defect reductions.
* Service \& Productivity \- Production\-plan attainment, schedule adherence, cycle performance, yield, waste and labour productivity.
* Reliability \- Effective breakdown response, equipment\-care compliance and reduction of recurring process losses. Plant maintenance compliances and autonomous maintenance Compliance.
* People \& HAPS \- Role qualification, multi\-skilling, engagement, DDS effectiveness and delivery of improvement actions.
* Effective CAPA closer and conducting root cause analysis and problem solving.
* Cost Management, Productivity, and overtime cost savings through continues improvements. Waste, Scrap and rework reduction.


**Job Posting End Date**
 2026\-09\-30
   

  

**Equal Opportunities**
 Haleon are committed to mobilising our purpose in a way that represents the diverse consumers and communities who rely on our brands every day. It guides us in creating an inclusive culture, where different backgrounds and views are valued and respected – all in support of understanding and best serving the needs of our consumers and unleashing the full potential of our people. It’s important to us that Haleon is a place where all our employees feel they truly belong.
   

  

 During the application process, we may ask you to share some personal information, which is entirely voluntary. This information ensures we meet certain regulatory and reporting obligations and supports the development, refinement, and execution of our inclusion and belonging programmes that are open to all Haleon employees.
   

  

 The personal information you provide will be kept confidential, used only for legitimate business purposes, and will never be used in making any employment decisions, including hiring decisions.

We’ll provide all reasonable adjustments to support you throughout the recruitment process and treat all information you provide us in confidence.

company: Aditya Birla Health Insurance Company Limited
description:
**Company Description** 
 Aditya Birla Health Insurance Company Limited (ABHICL), incorporated in 2015, is a joint venture within the Aditya Birla Group and global partners, focused exclusively on health insurance. Since commencing operations in 2016, the company has built a portfolio that includes chronic care solutions and incentivized wellness products. ABHICL positions itself as both a payer of healthcare expenses and an active enabler of better health choices, using product innovation to expand the health insurance landscape in India. Its philosophy centers on rewarding healthy behavior, guiding customers in managing lifestyle\-related conditions, protecting health needs with dignity, and providing easy access to a holistic health and wellness ecosystem through efficient, digital processes. Professionals joining ABHICL can expect to contribute to a mission\-driven, customer\-centric organization that integrates health, wellness, and technology.
 



**Role Description** 
 The Agency Manager is a full\-time, on\-site role based in Faridabad, responsible for driving business growth through the development and management of a network of insurance agents and partners. In this role, the individual will recruit, train, and mentor agency partners, monitor their performance, and support them in achieving sales and customer service targets. The Agency Manager will plan and execute local sales and marketing initiatives, analyze market opportunities, and ensure compliance with company policies and regulatory guidelines. Day\-to\-day responsibilities include tracking key performance metrics, conducting regular review meetings, resolving escalated customer issues, coordinating with internal teams for product and process updates, and maintaining strong relationships with stakeholders in the assigned territory. The role requires a proactive approach to expanding the customer base while promoting ABHICL’s health and wellness\-oriented insurance solutions.
 



**Qualifications** 







* Strong sales and business development skills, including experience in target\-driven environments, preferably within insurance, financial services, or healthcare.
* Proficiency in agency management and channel development, including recruiting, training, and supporting agents or partners to improve productivity and performance.
* Solid communication and interpersonal skills to build trust\-based relationships with customers, agents, and internal stakeholders, and to handle escalations effectively.
* Ability to analyze sales data and market trends, prepare performance reports, and use insights to plan territory strategies and optimize results.
* Good organizational and time\-management capabilities to handle multiple initiatives, review meetings, and operational follow\-ups efficiently.
* Working knowledge of basic office software and digital tools used for sales tracking, reporting, and customer relationship management.
* Bachelor’s degree in business, commerce, management, or a related field; an MBA or relevant postgraduate qualification is an advantage.
* Prior experience in health insurance or related domains is preferred, along with familiarity with regulatory compliance and ethical sales practices.

title: Duty Manager
description:
**Job Aim**
 Duty Manager, Facilities will be responsible for managing all aspects of day to day service delivery in Client site during the shift. He/ She also will be accountable for proper usage and functionality of the technologies implement at site
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Helpdesk/Mailroom Operations**
* To provide management advice on Helpdesk/Mailroom for escalated issues during the shift
* To ensure immediate response to all priority calls from employees and Siebel team during the shift and follow escalation process
* Clearing of C\-mail / Government agencies mail to the proper recipient.
* To ensure accident or crises management is addressed immediately


**Front Office Operations**
* To provide management advice for Front Office for escalated issues during the shift.
* To ensure immediate response to all priority calls during the shift and follow escalation process
* To take rounds of front office, lobby area, rest rooms to ensure a high standard of housekeeping \& upkeep


**Security Operations**
* Attending the shift briefing
* To ensure Security muster, deployment and make sure to acknowledge on the register for any penalties/comments for the improvement in security services
* To ensure that the security assignment manager or security in\-charge of the facility is being updated on the client’s/VIP visits

* To discuss and assist facility manager and security Manager (pan India) on monthly basis on the vendor performance matrix.
* To ensure the Grooming of the staff
* To manage the overall key room, clock room and time office operations.
* To ensure weekly training is imparted and staff grooming standard is maintained.
* To ensure VMT tool (vendor management tool) is up and run all the time
* To ensure all registers/tools update for material movements (In \& Out) on day to day basis
* Follow the escalation matrix if anything wrong
* Ensure to implement EHS practices (PPEs etc) in and around the security premises
* Ensure to update the new assets in the asset tracker \& update the relevant stake holders (WM \& CEs)


**Housekeeping Operations**
* Attending the shift briefing
* To ensure Housekeeping muster, deployment and ensure acknowledgment on the register for and penalties/comments for the improvement in housekeeping services.
* To ensure that the housekeeping duty manager or housekeeping in\-charge of the facility is being updated on the client’s/VIP visits.
* To ensure that the housekeeping related issues are discussed with housekeeping duty manager and also on priority for the shift and ensure there is an action and tracking for the issue closure.
* To ensure a facility walk through to check on all rest rooms, breakout area, workstations, meeting rooms, cabins, common areas, development areas for the quality of the housekeeping services.
* Identification, on time closure and reporting of snags.
* To discuss and assist facility manager on monthly basis on the vendor performance matrix.
* Ensure all the Siebel housekeeping calls are closed on priority and within TAT without escalations.


**Cafeteria Operations**
* To ensure caterers maintain a high standard of hygiene \& cleanliness in the services areas
* During food run out situation, ensure the matter is escalated to catering lead and coordinate with the catering vendor or any other alternative arrangements
* To ensure random food samples test is done by Client authorized vendor and results are taken up accordingly.
* To manage and supervise the quality, quantity and the cost of meal and refreshments being served in the cafeteria.
* To ensure that the operating hours, menus will be prominently displayed in all prominent places in the cafeteria.
* To conduct quarterly traffic analysis and ensure that waiting time on the cash counter and food counters and Sodexho counters shall be within tolerable limits.
* To ensure that the table \& chairs are cleaned at all times and the frequency shall be modulated according to the traffic.
* To ensure that tracking is done on the vendor crockery like spoons, plates etc. to ensure no shortages.
* Should conduct monthly random Kitchen audit of the vendors.
* Escalate Facility Manager and then Client on escalations.
* Ensure the hygiene of the cafeteria vendors operating in stalls.
* Ensure PPE are used by vendor staff while serving, cooking and washing.


**Estate Management**
* Ensure necessary approvals are taken by the builder team on cases to cases basis during specific events
* Coordination with builder on guarding services and common area upkeep daily / weekly / monthly
* Co\-ordinate with builder security for logistics requirement
* Co\-ordinate with builder for pest control activity closure
* Take proper rounds in all common areas maintained by builder
* Co\-ordination with builder HK team \& ensure daily HK activity in place in common areas
* Make snag reports pertaining to common area’s and follow up for closure
* Coordination for bee hive removals and pest control
* Coordination with builder security team for any logistics requirement


**General Operations**
* To ensure upkeep of breakout area \& reprographic equipment’s at all times and take necessary actions as required.
* To ensure all such communication is entered in the duty manager log book to inform the next shift person. Proper handing over and taking over to be done.
* To go for facility, walk around and ensure Walk around map \& Guide is followed and maintained.
* To adhere to Client Policies, Processes \& procedures and also the statutory documents
* To adhere to Client SLA \& KPI as agreed with JLL
* To assist Facility Manager in all such ISO, Internal, External, audits that happen at Client Site and ensure necessary documentation are done
* To coordinate with engineering team for any issues that need help.
* Organizing induction program for all TPV \& Jll staff
* Plan \& train TPV staff on Client policies and requirements.
* Daily and monthly updating of OLA in the SMDRS tool.
* Important and VIP client visits to be coordinated with Events team and should be managed without escalations.
* Should have complete knowledge \& functionality e.Fit tools ( VMT, IMT, Site Ops. Site Inspection tool), BGC and work permit tool.
* Should govern overall pest control, carpet maintenance, Wellness room, Ambulance, Indoor plants, Recreation room and Gym activities.
* Should conduct all the scheduled meeting and focus meets with projects as per calendar.
* Should participate and manage half yearly fire drill.
* All daily, weekly and monthly reports to be shared on time.
* All the relevant checklist to be governed and maintained as per requirement.
* Adopt to all the new implemented initiatives.
* Handling of security, EHS incidents on priority and communicating the same as per escalation matrix.
* Answering the employee query on phone and replying mails
* Follow the escalation process \& matrix for any incident / issues (100%)

title: BIM Lead / VP – Production
description:
BIM Lead / VP – Production
 



  





**Location:** 
 Ahmedabad, Gujarat — 100% In\-Office (Candidates from anywhere in India welcome to apply; relocation to Ahmedabad required)
 **Experience:** 
 8\+ Years (Multi\-Discipline BIM Production \& Team Leadership)
 **Employment Type:** 
 Full\-Time \| Minimum 2\.5\-Year Service Commitment (Employment Bond \+ Strict NDA applicable)
 **Reports To:** 
 Founder / CEO
 



  





 About Us
 



  





**BIM Expert Studio** 
 is a fast\-growing BIM and CAD outsourcing company based in Ahmedabad, India, delivering Architecture, Structural, MEPF, and Scan\-to\-BIM production services to Architecture, Engineering \& Construction (AEC) firms, building surveyors, and MEPF/General Contractors across the United States. We work across multiple project types and disciplines with a production team built to scale.
 



 We're looking for a hands\-on BIM Lead / VP – Production to own end\-to\-end technical delivery, build and lead our modeling team, and become the technical backbone of the company as we scale production capacity.
 



  





 Role Summary
 



  





 This is a senior, hands\-on leadership role — not a purely managerial one. You will be the final technical authority across every discipline we serve (Architecture, Structural, MEPF, Scan\-to\-BIM), responsible for making sure any project that comes in from a US client — regardless of discipline or project type — can be delivered correctly, on time, and to US AEC documentation standards. You will also build out the production bench itself: hiring, training, and developing modelers and drafters as the team scales.
 



  





 Key Responsibilities
 



  




1. Own end\-to\-end technical delivery across all disciplines — Architecture, Structural, MEPF, and Scan\-to\-BIM — for every incoming client project, regardless of discipline or project type.
2. Review incoming project scopes from US clients and determine discipline, LOD, staffing, and timeline requirements.
3. Set up and enforce BIM Execution Plans (BEPs), modeling standards, and QA/QC checkpoints for every project.
4. Directly model, troubleshoot, or unblock any discipline when the team hits a technical wall — you should be able to open any file and solve the problem yourself.
5. Hire, onboard, and train BIM modelers and drafters across disciplines as the team scales; build internal training/SOP material for new hires.
6. Allocate resources and manage capacity planning across multiple concurrent projects and deadlines.
7. Run multi\-discipline coordination and clash detection reviews before deliverables go out.
8. Act as the primary technical point of contact for US clients on project\-specific queries, scope clarifications, and escalations.
9. Standardize templates, families, and content libraries across disciplines to improve production speed and consistency.
10. Mentor and develop team leads under you so the production team can eventually run with less day\-to\-day involvement from you.
11. Track and report production KPIs (turnaround time, rework rate, capacity utilization) to leadership.
12. Maintain strict confidentiality of client data, drawings, and business information at all times.



  





 Technical Skills Required
 



  





 1\. Architectural BIM
 



  




1. Full concept\-to\-Construction Documents (CD) production: floor plans, elevations, sections, RCPs, schedules, and detailing
2. Experience across multiple project types — residential (multi\-family/single\-family), commercial, hospitality, healthcare, education, and industrial
3. Revit family creation and library management across LOD 100–500
4. Working knowledge of US code frameworks (IBC, ADA) as they apply to documentation accuracy
5. Renovation, addition, and adaptive\-reuse modeling from existing/as\-built conditions
6. Interior architecture and tenant improvement (TI) documentation



  





 2\. Structural BIM
 



  




1. Steel, concrete, wood\-frame, and light\-gauge structural modeling
2. Rebar detailing and structural shop drawing coordination
3. Framing plans, connections, and structural detailing
4. Translating structural engineers' design intent and calculations into accurate models
5. Foundation, podium, and structural steel detailing
6. Structural clash resolution against architectural and MEPF models



  





 3\. MEPF (Mechanical, Electrical, Plumbing, Fire Protection)
 



  




1. HVAC ductwork, piping, and equipment modeling
2. Electrical power, lighting, low\-voltage systems, and panel schedule modeling
3. Plumbing supply, waste, and vent system modeling
4. Fire protection and sprinkler system layout and modeling
5. Multi\-system MEPF coordination for clash\-free installation
6. Spool and fabrication drawing generation to support prefabrication workflows



  





 4\. Scan\-to\-BIM / Reality Capture
 



  




1. Point cloud registration and cleanup (Recap, Cyclone, or equivalent)
2. As\-built modeling directly from point cloud/laser scan data
3. Existing conditions documentation for renovation and retrofit projects
4. Accuracy validation and QA of scan\-derived models against source data
5. Integrating scan\-based models into ongoing design/coordination workflows



  





 5\. Software \& Platform Proficiency
 



  




1. Autodesk Revit (Architecture, Structure, MEP)
2. AutoCAD / AutoCAD MEP
