title: Merchandise Manager
description:
**Company Description** 




 Toram Creators Private Limited is a knitwear and apparel manufacturer based in Tirupur, Tamil Nadu. Founded in 2003, we operate across multiple production units with end\-to\-end capabilities spanning product development, sampling, quality control, and finishing.
 



 We serve a strong portfolio of domestic retail and export brands — including Walmart, GAP, and Fruit of the Loom — delivering across inner garments, knitwear, and lifestyle apparel. Our facilities are certified for SEDEX, BCI, and Disney FAMA.
 



 We are in an active phase of organisational growth — building systems, strengthening our team, and investing in the people and processes that will define the next chapter of Toram. This role is part of that build.
 



  





  





**Role Description** 




 We are looking for a Merchandising Manager to own the day\-to\-day execution of our brand accounts and lead our merchandising team.
 



 Toram currently runs three active brand accounts, each managed by a senior merchandiser. This role exists to sit above that team — to see across all three accounts simultaneously, hold the merchandisers accountable to TNA and quality standards, own buyer communication at the execution level, and ensure that nothing falls through the gap between an order landing and a shipment going out.
 



 Our Managing Director owns the strategic buyer relationship — new orders, quarterly reviews, and account\-level commercial decisions. You own everything in between. The daily and weekly execution rhythm that determines whether buyers stay, grow, and reorder is your accountability.
 



*If you are someone who has spent years in merchandising and has now moved — or is ready to move — from doing the work to managing the function, this role was built for you.* 




  





  





**Experience** 




 ● 8–12 years in garment or knitwear merchandising, with at least 3 years in a senior or managerial role managing a team and multiple accounts simultaneously.
 



 ● Direct experience with domestic retail brand accounts — Westside, Zudio, Max, Myntra, Clovia, DaMensch, or comparable. You understand how domestic retail buyers operate, what their timelines look like, and how their teams are structured.
 



 ● Strong TNA management — you have built TNA calendars, tracked them across concurrent orders, and held your team accountable against them. You know what a missed milestone costs.
 



 ● ERP comfort — you are used to working within a system and understand that what is not in the system does not exist.
 



  





**The kind of person we are looking for** 




 ● You manage the function, not just the accounts. You are not the person chasing fabric or writing every buyer email — you are the person who ensures your team does those things correctly and on time.
 



 ● You communicate clearly and do not leave room for misunderstanding — with buyers, with the factory, and with your team. You know when to call versus email, and your emails can be forwarded without editing.
 



 ● You are comfortable holding difficult buyer conversations — delivering bad news, managing a delay, proposing a solution — without escalating to your manager first.
 



 ● You are disciplined about documentation. If you left tomorrow, your team could pick up your accounts from what is in the system.
 



 ● You are based in Tirupur or genuinely willing to relocate. This is an on\-site role.
 



  





**What We Offer** 




 ● A direct reporting line to the Managing Director — not a VP layer above you. Your decisions matter and your inputs are heard.
 



 ● Three active brand accounts already running, a merchandising team already in place, and a clear mandate to improve how the function performs — you are not starting from zero.
 



 ● A company genuinely in growth mode — new buyers, new product categories, improving systems — and a role that will grow with it.
 



 ● Competitive compensation discussed at interview. We are serious about this hire and will pay accordingly.

description:

The incumbent will act as a key link between Programming/Content team and Sales teams and drive the brand philosophy and sales/revenue strategy for the channel to optimize channel inventory. This will be done through effective forecasting, planning, pricing and property integrations based on deep understanding of customer needs and patterns
* Key Responsibilities


**Strategic / Policy related KRAs**
 Customer and Pricing Strategy:
   

  

* Defining the pricing strategy along with the PRS Head and National Genre Head for the channel/cluster basis
* organization objectives, budget for the year, market scenario, competition, etc. in order to ensure the sales organization achieves overall revenue target.
* Driving the channel pricing agenda \- setting benchmarks, providing inputs and sign\-offs on deals, and participating in deal negotiations as and when required
* Build client wise strategy/ deal structuring for the channel which includes creating and recommending client pricing
* options for individual client deals, building monthly client packages including decisions on what time bands to allocate to each client based on what works for their target segments and track deviations in delivery
* Build sponsor packages for impact shows and ensure maximum monetization for each property on the channel
* Build band wise revenue budget, show and property wise pricing including determination of sponsor packages
* Create and maintain strategies based on key genres to help understand the genre behavior, trends, movements etc. that may have impact on business.


**Strategic Forecasting:**
* Creating revenue business plan across portfolio of channels in a particular genre
* Building bottom\-up revenue plans for the fiscal, quarter \& month
* Tracking performance vs. annual plan, revising forecasts etc.


**Operational / Process / Technology related KRAs**
 Product Understanding
   

  

* Developing insights into the genre \& channel deliveries to develop customized pitches for clients
* Creating \& implementing trade marketing agenda for the channel – Mailers, On Air promos, Trade events etc.
* Define a measurement process to ensure that client and agency are aligned on key performance metrics, establishing realistic business goals, and providing frontline support through reporting and analytics
* Impact landscape sizing of a particular genre – understand the kind of impact properties across channels, changes and evolutions compared to the previous year and deeper understanding of the advertisers who buy impact


**Cross functional collaboration:**
* Engage with sales teams for ensuring revenue rationalization by forecasting projections/trends for a healthy business and designing attractive packages for the sales team to take to the market, conducting roadshows.
* Prepare the sales team so they can handle queries from clients and media planners/buyers with confidence.
* Supporting ad sales team with operational tasks on rate cards, internal deal approvals, client sales proposals etc.
* Liaise with the Programming teams and build a thorough understanding of the channel objectives and performance in order to identify monetization opportunities, as also provide market / sales feedback in relation to channel properties.
* Work collaboratively across Sales and Ops to ensure seamless delivery on deals from a client perspective, as well as inventory optimization and revenue maximization from a business perspective


**Use of Tools and Systems :**
* Building an understanding of the industry and clients through industry reports, trends, articles and BARC data to know plans of our key clients and categories to pre\-empt the sales team for proactive pitching.
* Analyze market trends, Media performance versus Brand parameters and other critical trends.
* Helps building client dockets to understand the advertising patterns for key advertisers versus competition genre wise, channel wise, brand wise, market wise and make recommendations basis the same to improve the efficiency of clients’ buys.
* Deep dive on how advertisers in various sectors buy across genres – understanding the top categories, players, buying mix, impact purchased, channel mix, etc


**Financial Accountability / Commercial Impact**
* Revenue and Yield Delivery
* Working along with the sales team to ensure revenue targets are met
* Achieve yield objectives of annual plan
* Maximise channel/genre revenues across time slots, execute corrections and manage monthly revenues.
* Develop a strategy for the next year including customer strategy, pricing strategy and programme wise plans to add up to the channel revenue


**Competitive analysis and Benchmarking –**
* understand what the competition is doing and be agile to take decisions based on Supply, demand and other macro factors
* Prepare client pitch decks, Monthly/Quarterly review decks along with the team


**Stake holder management –**
* Liase with programming on the FPC and suggest changes based on the feedback from sales, monetization potential and demand situation.
* Problem solving skills are mandatory

* Strategic planning
* Influencing Skills
* Result Orientation
* Negotiation Skills
* Analytical thinking
* People management Skill
* Preferred Education \& Experience
* Minimum Qualification : MBA/PGDBM (Premier or Tier 1 management institute)
* With at least 10\-13 years of post\-qualification experience

title: Site Engineer- Civil
description:
Being the go\-to MEP/CIVIL person
   

  

 Are you considered to be the go\-to person for all MEP/CIVIL matters? That’s what you’ll be in this role. You’ll manage all activities related to mechanical, engineering and plumbing in terms of planning, designing, procurement, construction, testing and commissioning, and final handover. Your task is to fully understand, collect and deliver clients’ MEP/CIVIL requirements. The design manager in MEP/CIVIL will depend on you to help schedule or plan establishment, value engineer, and design change management. You’ll also assist the contract manager in MEP/CIVIL\-related procurement and VO management. On top of that, you’ll support the construction manager in MEP/CIVIL\-related installation, site inspection and contractor management.
   

  

 Making visions come true
   

  

 You’ll develop big ideas that will spark the effective management and successful execution of all phases of a project—from initiating, designing, planning, controlling, executing, monitoring, and closing. You’ll need to carefully identify and take note of our clients’ needs, and figure out what exactly needs to be done. This involves defining the scope of the work and expected outcome, while also detailing all the necessary objectives to get there.
   

  

 While you do all of these, you’ll need to keep tabs on company resources used in the projects, and to allocate these resources to complete the project within the budget. You’ll also need to help clients organize and analyze all tender and procurement for all contractors and suppliers; and represent them from the beginning to the end of a project.
   

  

 Building strong teams and business reputation
   

  

 One of your priorities will be to produce high\-performing teams that drive successful project execution. You’ll also represent and promote the company throughout projects and in pursuit of more project opportunities.
   

  

 Keeping risks at bay
   

  

 How do you deal with risks? You’ll need to identify any potential risks in the MEP/CIVIL field and report them to the Project Manager. It will be critical to design a risk management and solution provision, particularly to identify health \& safety issues. You will understand why this is your responsibility.
   

  

**Sound like you? To apply you need to be:**
 An MEP/CIVIL pro
   

  

 You have a degree in MEP/CIVIL engineering\-related discipline or related field, and five years of combined educational and work experience. You also need to have sufficient experience in construction site management, as well as a strong understanding of all aspects of development management including, financial appraisal, risk management, negotiation, etc.
   

  

 Do you have a strong background of all aspects of MEP/CIVIL\-related management—including the development of MEP/CIVIL project plan and procedures and construction schedules? Are you familiar with HVAC, electrical engineering, and BMS? Do you have knowledge of security system, AV system, and IT system? If your answers are yes, let’s talk.
   

  

 A business savvy leader who can walk the talk
   

  

 You understand the business well enough, particularly in terms of the systems and tools to use, the best practices and the safety requirements. You’re also knowledgeable of key industries and local market, with the real estate and construction business above all. You also have a basic understanding of the key drivers that push the projects forward, while also considering the client’s business requirements.
   

  

 You’ll back up your business know\-hows with the necessary communication skills, as you need to regularly do business development presentations to potential clients in both English and Chinese. You’ll also manage site activities, negotiate with contractors, review the legal aspects of contracts, contribute to market analysis, and manage change orders.
   

  

 A flexible leader with superb interpersonal skills
   

  

 Are you a people person with superb interpersonal skills? You’ll need to create a proactive working environment that not only motivates your employees, but also encourages them to maintain good relationship with clients, communicate effectively with each other, and contribute enthusiastically to the project. You also need to be a results\-oriented leader with good problem\-solving skills, as well as someone who can nurture positive relationships with all stakeholders involved, including your team members and clients.
   

  

**What we can do for you:**
 At JLL, we make sure that you become the best version of yourself by helping you realise your full potential in an entrepreneurial and inclusive work environment. We will empower your ambitions through our dedicated Total Rewards Program, competitive pay and benefits package.
   

  

 Apply today!

Ensure adherence to hospital financial policies, including the 80% advance payment policy , wherever applicable. Ensure that all hospital staff maintain cordial, helpful, respectful, and empathetic communication with patients and their caregivers. Review outstanding/due payment cases with the Recovery Coordinator and escalate critical cases to the appropriate authorities. Resolve concession-related financial matters in coordination with consultants and senior management authorities. Conduct daily follow-up with the Financial Recovery Executive regarding outstanding IPD dues; ensure daily dues are reviewed and communicated to patient relatives, and highlight significant outstanding amounts to the Head of Hospital. Accompany the Chairman and Head of Hospital during daily rounds and ensure timely closure of observations and action points. Facilitate bed availability for new admissions by optimising room allocation, including conversion of single-occupancy rooms to semi-private/general categories when required and as per hospital policy. Handle VIP, influential, and other sensitive patient cases discreetly and professionally, particularly with regard to financial and service-related matters. Address and counsel patients/caregivers regarding billing-related queries , coordinating with the Billing Department wherever required. Make necessary arrangements and coordinate IPD requirements for health camps, academic courses, examinations, inspections, audits, and other institutional activities . Take responsibility for training and development programmes for IPD staff to enhance service quality, operational knowledge, and patient experience. Attend meetings at various healthcare offices, regulatory bodies, or external/internal forums as directed by management. Ensure completion of IPD-related HR and manpower activities , including shift changes, leave management, swipe/attendance requests, and duty rosters.  About Krishitek Krishitek Industries Pvt. Ltd. is an Indian manufacturer of agricultural machinery, focused on developing practical, reliable and farmer-oriented mechanization solutions. We are looking for an experienced Manager – Technical & Operations who can lead our Design & Development and Production functions while driving effective cross-functional coordination across Purchase, Quality, Dispatch, After-Sales Service (technical support) and OEM/technical partners. This is a senior, hands-on role for a professional who understands the complete product lifecycle — Design Development Manufacturing Quality Field Performance Product Improvement . 
 Key Responsibilities 1. Design & Product Development Lead the Design & Development function and manage engineering priorities. Lead new product development and existing product improvement initiatives. Review and guide engineering drawings, BOMs, specifications and design changes. Ensure products are practical, reliable, cost-effective and manufacturable. Drive Design for Manufacturing (DFM) and Design for Assembly (DFA). Coordinate prototype development, testing, validation and implementation. Convert field/customer requirements into meaningful product improvements. Build engineering standards, documentation and design processes. 2. Production & Manufacturing Lead and coordinate with the Production team to achieve production targets. Identify and resolve production bottlenecks. Improve productivity, manufacturing processes and resource utilization. Ensure smooth transition of new/modified products from Design to Production. Coordinate with fabrication, machining, assembly and outsourced manufacturing partners. Reduce rejection, rework, downtime and production losses. Ensure manufacturability is considered during product development. 3. Purchase & Vendor Technical Coordination Define technical specifications for critical components and materials. Technically evaluate and develop vendors. Support Purchase in vendor selection and technical evaluation. Identify alternate materials/components for cost, quality and availability improvement. Resolve technical issues with suppliers. Drive technical development of critical suppliers. 4. Quality & Root Cause Analysis Work closely with Quality and Production teams to identify root causes of product/process issues. Lead technical Root Cause Analysis (RCA) and corrective actions. Eliminate recurring quality problems. Analyse rejection, rework and field-failure trends. Drive continuous improvement in product and process quality. 5. After-Sales & Product Performance Provide technical support for major product/service issues. Analyse field failures and identify design, manufacturing or process-related root causes. Establish a feedback loop from Customer Service Design Production . Drive product improvements based on field performance. Reduce recurring technical complaints and warranty issues. 6. OEM & External Technical Coordination Coordinate technical discussions with OEMs, technology partners and external agencies. Understand OEM requirements and translate them into internal execution. Lead technical trials, modifications and product integration. Manage technical communication with external partners. 7. Process & Cost Improvement Identify opportunities for product and manufacturing cost reduction. Improve material utilization, process efficiency and product design. Evaluate make-vs-buy opportunities. Reduce unnecessary components, processes and manufacturing complexity. Drive continuous improvement initiatives. 8. Management & Strategic Support Provide the Managing Director with technical and operational insights for decision-making. Analyse production constraints, product costs, technical risks, supplier issues and capacity requirements. Support strategic decisions related to new products, manufacturing and process improvement. **Manager – IT Operations** 




  





**Job Summary** 




 The Manager – IT Operations will be responsible for administering, securing, and governing the organization's enterprise IT platforms, identity management systems, business applications, network infrastructure, backup systems, and operational processes.
 



  





 The role requires a technically strong individual with hands\-on experience in Microsoft 365, Microsoft Entra ID, Intune, Active Directory, Privileged Access Management (PAM), Data Loss Prevention (DLP), DPDPA compliance controls, CRM administration, network administration, and enterprise application support.
 



  





 The incumbent will act as the primary owner for enterprise IT operations and will work closely with Information Security, Infrastructure, Compliance, and Business teams to ensure the availability, security, compliance, and performance of business\-critical systems. The position requires a candidate capable of operating at an L2/L3 administration level while driving operational excellence and governance initiatives across the organization.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**Enterprise Identity \& Access Management** 



* Administer Microsoft 365, Microsoft Entra ID, Active Directory, Exchange Online, and Microsoft Intune environments.
* Manage enterprise identity lifecycle processes, including provisioning, role changes, access governance, and deprovisioning.
* Design, implement, and maintain Conditional Access Policies, Multi\-Factor Authentication (MFA), and Zero Trust security controls.
* Administer privileged access controls and PAM solutions to ensure secure access to critical systems.
* Conduct periodic access reviews, entitlement audits, and privilege validation exercises.



  





**Enterprise Application Administration** 



* Serve as the operational admin for enterprise applications including CRM, HRMS, Attendance Management Systems, Learning Management Systems, Service Desk platforms, and other business\-critical applications.
* Manage application configurations, workflows, integrations, user roles, permissions, and security controls.
* Coordinate with application vendors and internal stakeholders for upgrades, enhancements, and issue resolution.
* Ensure high availability, performance, and security of enterprise applications.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives for application usage and operational efficiency.



  





**Information Security, DLP \& DPDPA Compliance** 



* Implement and administer Data Loss Prevention (DLP) controls across Microsoft 365 and enterprise applications.
* Support organizational compliance initiatives related to the Digital Personal Data Protection Act (DPDPA) and other regulatory requirements.
* Collaborate with Information Security teams on security governance, risk mitigation, vulnerability remediation, and audit preparedness.
* Monitor compliance with information security policies and standards.
* Participate in security incident investigations and remediation activities.
* VAPT findings resolution.



**Network \& Infrastructure Operations** 



* Oversee administration and monitoring of enterprise network infrastructure including firewalls, routers, switches, SD\-WAN, VPNs, wireless networks, and internet connectivity.
* Coordinate with infrastructure teams, vendors, and service providers to ensure stable and secure network operations.
* Support infrastructure modernization, cloud adoption, and operational improvement initiatives.
* Review network performance, availability, and security posture on a regular basis
 **.**



  





**Backup, Recovery \& Business Continuity** 



* Own enterprise backup and recovery operations across servers, applications, databases, and cloud platforms.
* Ensure backup schedules, retention policies, and recovery objectives are achieved and periodically validated.
* Conduct backup restoration testing and disaster recovery exercises.
* Support business continuity planning and operational resilience initiatives.
* Maintain recovery documentation, operational runbooks, and audit evidence.



  





**Governance, Reporting \& Operational Excellence** 



* Develop and maintain operational dashboards, MIS reports, compliance reports, and management metrics.
* Present periodic operational reviews, risk assessments, and service performance reports to management.
* Define and maintain operational procedures, standards, and documentation.
* Ensure adherence to ITIL\-based incident, change, problem, and access management processes.
* Drive automation and process optimization initiatives to improve efficiency and reduce operational risks.



  





**Vendor \& Stakeholder Management** 



* Manage relationships with application vendors, service providers, OEMs, and implementation partners.
* Coordinate technology upgrades, renewals, support contracts, and operational escalations.
* Act as the primary point of contact for business stakeholders regarding enterprise application and operational issues.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to support strategic technology initiatives.



  





**Qualification \& Experience** 




**Educational Qualification** 



* Bachelor's Degree or higher in Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related discipline.



  





**Experience** 



* 5 to 8 years of experience in IT Operations, Enterprise Systems Administration, Infrastructure Management, Application Administration, or Information Security Operations.
* Proven experience managing enterprise platforms and business\-critical IT services.
* Experience supporting regulated environments and compliance\-driven organizations will be preferred.



  





**Preferred Certifications** 



* Microsoft 365 Certified Administrator Expert
* Microsoft Identity and Access Administrator
* Microsoft Security Administrator
* Microsoft Intune Administrator
* ITIL Foundation / ITIL 4



  





**Technical Skills**

* Microsoft 365 Administration

* Exchange Online

**Desired Competencies**

 Eunoia Designtech, founded in 2016 and based in Ahmedabad, is a design consultancy focused on transforming bold ideas into practical, high\-impact solutions. The team combines mechanical design, web development, graphic design, branding, printing, and digital marketing to deliver creative work aligned with clear business goals. By deeply understanding each brand’s objectives and audience, Eunoia Designtech creates campaigns and solutions that perform strategically and maximize ROI. The company has partnered with over 150 clients across diverse industries such as FMCG, textiles, real estate, architecture, cosmetics, retail, agriculture, pharmaceuticals, and finance. Integrating technology, creativity, and strategy, Eunoia Designtech’s promise is simple: if you can think it, they can develop it.
   

**Role Description** 
 The Operations Manager will oversee daily operations across design, development, and marketing projects to ensure smooth workflows and timely delivery. This full\-time, on\-site role in Ahmedabad involves coordinating cross\-functional teams, optimizing processes, managing resource allocation, and monitoring project progress against timelines and quality standards. The Operations Manager will implement and refine operational policies, maintain documentation, and use data to identify opportunities for efficiency and performance improvement. The role includes collaborating with leadership on planning, budgeting, and capacity management, as well as supporting client servicing teams to meet project requirements and resolve operational issues. The Operations Manager will also help nurture a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, and effective communication within the organization.

* Strong operations management skills, including process optimization, workflow design, and resource planning.
* Experience with project management practices, tools, and methodologies in design, development, or marketing environments.
* Ability to coordinate cross\-functional teams, manage priorities, and ensure alignment with business objectives.
* Solid analytical and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to interpret data and use insights to drive decisions.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with a focus on clear, structured reporting and stakeholder updates.
* Proficiency in using productivity and collaboration tools (e.g., project management platforms, spreadsheets, documentation tools).
* Demonstrated experience in a managerial or supervisory role, preferably within a creative, tech, or consulting organization.
* Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Operations Management, Engineering, or a related field; advanced qualifications are a plus.
* Detail\-oriented, organized, and comfortable working in a fast\-paced, deadline\-driven environment.
* Understanding of design, web development, and digital marketing workflows is highly beneficial.
